matthew lin.name: Matthew Lin
matthew lin.origin: Matt Lin attended Alexander Hamilton High School, which he hated. He graduated late after making up for two incomplete tries in summer school. He subsequently joined the U.S. Army, and served two tours in Iraq and one in Afghanistan. When he returned to America, he worked in retail for a few years at a bookstore, and eventually joined the Arlington County Police Department where he became a detective after two years and later killed a man named Francois Puvot during an officer-involved shooting. Detective Lin was assigned to investigate the case of Chris Kinzky's murder, and interrogated Vision due to his son's recent altercation with Chris some days before his death. Some time later, Vision's wife, Virginia, called Detective Lin and confessed to her role in Chris Kinzky's death.

matthew malloy.name: Matthew Malloy
matthew malloy.origin: Matthew and his wife Jules lived in Charleston, South Carolina when the Earth was attacked during the Skrull Invasion. During an argument between the two of them, Matthew witnessed the death of his wife. She was vaporized by one of the energy blasts from a Skrull ship. As he came face to face with a Skrull agent that was about to shoot him, a S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier that had been in the area flew over his newly destroyed home and blew the Skrull's head from his shoulders. A year later, Matthew moved to Newberry where he ran into his former sister-in-law, Alana. Still suffering from the unimaginable trauma he experienced when he witnessed his wife's death, she tried to assure him that even though her sister was gone she still considered him as her brother. Her heartfelt words went unwarranted, with his memories refreshed his emotional breaking point was reached. His mutant abilities manifested and quickly were out of his control. A sudden eruption of energy followed, destroying everything around him. Adding to his grief, this explosion killed Alana. 250px|left|thumb|Matthew unleashes his powers After the incident, Matthew stood in the massive sinkhole he created contemplating what just had happened. He was then approached by a robotic drone with a holographic image of Director Maria Hill, who questioned him if he was responsible for the disaster and if he was a mutant. With his powers manifested and yet uncontrolled, he was once again pushed beyond his emotional limits. Unhinged, he could not be calmed down by Maria. Instead, she sent a strike team to his location only for him to uncontrollably release his power and obliterate everyone in the area. It was revealed that Matthew had been encountered by Professor Charles Xavier in the past, and Xavier had used his telepathic powers to block Malloy's abilities, fearing he would otherwise destroy the world. With Xavier then deceased, there was nothing stopping Matthew. Later on, S.H.I.E.L.D. sent an air strike that obliterated him, Cyclops, and Magik. Using his powers, he returned back to life and teleported to the Jean Grey School. There, Emma Frost confronted him, scaring Matthew and causing him to kill her. X-Man Tempus then used her powers to go back in time and with the help of the Professor X of the past managed to make Malloy's parents never meet, causing him to never have been born and cease to exist in the present and thus saving Scott, Illyana, and Emma from death.
weaknesses: Extreme emotion causes Malloy to unleash his power unintentionally and often with devastating results.

matthew rogers.name: Matthew Rogers
matthew rogers.origin: Matthew Rogers was the first born of Joseph and Sarah Rogers, American immigrants that originated from Ireland. They were poor and struggled during the Great Depression. Matthew became sickly and had to walk in crutches, the exact nature of his illness is unknown, but he died at a young age. Joseph and Sarah had a second son, Steven, who would grow up to be Captain America. Growing up as a child, Steve never knew that he had an older brother who died prior to his birth. Matthew and his parents lived out their afterlives in the Realm of the Dead in a section that resembled New York during the Depression Era. Living in a ramshackle home, they lived a life of eternal poverty. In modern times, Matthew's brother Steve would aid Mar-Vell in destroying Death and creating a Paradise in the Realm of the Dead. Steve was transmogrified into a member of the Avenging Host, "angels" charged with defending Paradise and convincing those in the Realm of the Dead that they were deceased so that they can gain access to Paradise. Of the people that Steve Rogers was attempting to convince was his own family, disguising himself as a World War I soldier and renting out a room in their home. Steve was surprised by the revelation that he had an older brother. Steve struggled with finding a way of explaining everything to his family, not being sure he could explain the situation in terms that they could comprehend. Following Steve's part in liberating Paradise from an invasion from the alien Kree, he returned to his parents with new insight on the nature of Paradise. If Steve was able to convince the Rogers clan to join him in Paradise or not remains unrevealed.

matthew storm.name: Matthew Storm
matthew storm.origin: Matthew Storm was the son of two super-heroes - Johnny Storm (Human Torch) and Janet Van Dyne (Wasp) - from an alternate reality. Unlike his hotheaded father and assertive mother, Matthew had more of a nervous personality. In this reality, the heroes and villains assembled by the Beyonder to fight in the conflict known as the Secret Wars never left Battleworld, the patchwork planet created by the Beyonder for them to fight on. After the heroes and villains called a truce, many of them settled down to raise families in a portion of the city of Denver, Colorado that formed part of the planet. When their children were in their late teens, Vincent, the son of Doctor Doom and Enchantress, assembled a team of the villains' children and battled the children of the heroes, including Firefly, until their parents intervened. After the altercation, the heroes' children used a device created by the Hulk to travel back to Earth. However, they arrived on an alternate Earth where the Sentinels ruled America and had wiped out most of the planet's mutants and super-humans. After defeating one of the robots, the kids decided they had a purpose - to rid the world of the Sentinels.
powers: Matthew has the powers of both his parents: , , and . Matt can also produce made of solar energy that up one's molecules to the extent that the person will be incinerated.
weaknesses: Matt needs to be around the sun or any heated cosmic force to himself up. If Matthew were to overexert himself too much, he would be left powerless.

matthew woalcott.name: Matthew Woalcott
matthew woalcott.origin: Matthew Woalcott was a skilled wood engraver and exhibited his work at the craft fair held annually in Hartsdale, Massachusetts for eight years. During his eighth exhibitions, blind Alicia Masters showed up and picked up one of his works to view it with her touch, but this annoyed Woalcott, who snatched the work from her hands and after knowing that she was blind he responded rudely to her by telling her to move away from his stall for fear that she would stumble over one of his works and ruin them. This rude way of treating Masters infuriated her boyfriend the Thing, who was there with her; the Thing taught Woalcott a lesson by bringing him a large whole tree in front of his stall telling him that for the time he would take care of that tree it would have to be enough for him to learn good manners. Following the arrival of the Star-Dancer who covered the town with an indestructible dome trapping the people inside, Woalcott incited the population to lynch Masters, who remained inside the dome while Ben was outside of it. Woalcott suggested that Masters had been in league with the monstruous Thing, meaning that she was probably also in league with the scary Star-Dancer; the panicked crowd indeed grabbed Masters, and Woalcott put a gun on her head, threatening to kill her lest the Star-Dancer leave. Fortunately the elderly superhero Blue Diamond intervened in shooting her and defeated Woalcott and the other brawlers, saving Masters's life.
weapons: Woalcott had a handgun.

mattias van scotter.name: Mattias van Scotter
mattias van scotter.origin: Mattias van Scotter was a South African of Afrikaner descent. He was crew on a boat a school charted for an art class, where he met a girl of Zulu descent named Amahle. Due to Mattias' shyness, Amahle took the initiative and approached him. They married years later, and together they had a daughter named Jubulile. Mattias taught his daughter to sail when she was extremely young, and they planned on building a boat to sail the world together. However, some time before Jubulile turned 16, he passed away from a terminal illness. Jubulile set out to finish building their boat, the Cinga, and embarked on her own to explore the world in his memory.

mattie baptiste.species: Human mystic; possibly descendant of Angel
mattie baptiste.origin: Tante Mattie was born in the 19th century, but has aged at a significantly reduced rate. She was part of the Grigori, a sect whose members were allegedly the descendants of the eponymous group of Angels. When she was a child, time-travelling Gambit saved her. In gratitude, she often helped him and treated him like a son when she met the younger Remy LeBeau years later. She was the traiteur for both New Orleans' Guilds, and a highly religious woman, who used her magical powers to heal and guide them.

matzu.name: Matzu
matzu.origin: Matzu was a Japanese spy active in America during the 1940s. When the Chinese community of New York City were organizing a fundraiser to generate money for the war effort to stop Imperial Japan's invasion of China, he received orders to prevent this from happening. During this time he hired the greedy Ku-Shi, a Chinese-American who was willing to betray his native country to satisfy his desire for riches. Together, the two set fire to the building where all the fund raisers' fireworks were being stored. However the fire was stopped by the Human Torch and Toro. Ku-Shi convinced the two heroes to participate in the fund raiser. He reported this development back to Matzu, and the two villains conspired to not only steal the money collected in the fundraiser but also to eliminate the two flame masters. In the middle of the fund raiser, Matzu and his men stormed through the crowd, gunning down innocent people and stealing the money. The Torch and Toro rushed after the crooks, following them back to Matzu's hideout. There, they blithely stumbled into a trap where they were exposed to sleeping gas. Groggy from the gas, they were helpless against Matzu's hypnotic powers and he forced the two heroes to rob the Bank of Free China and bring the money to him. When the Torch broke free of Matzu's control, the Japanese spy set Toro to fight his partner. However, the Torch snapped Toro out of Matzu's control as well. The two heroes easily captured the spy and turned him over to the authorities, while returning the stolen money.
abilities: Matzu was a hypnotist, the strength of his hypnotic power appeared to rely on the use of a anesthetic gas that rendered his targets too groggy to resist his hypnotic powers.
weapons: Matzu had access to automatic weapons.

She was betrayed by her first mate, Jebediah Fate, who sold her to the satyr Khordes in exchange for treasure. maureen denton.name: Maureen Denton
maureen denton.origin: Maureen Denton was the mother of Jack Denton, an ambulance driver who mysteriously disappeared after responding to a bus crash. Three weeks after his disappearance, Maureen was called by the hospital who located Jack on the verge of death in an alley. It was revealed Jack had donated both of his kidneys, and would be in need of machines to survive. Luckily, a mysterious donor donated a dialysis machine to the Dentons. Maureen believed this to be a miracle from God, for her son did an incredibly generous deed by donating both his kidneys and was able to return home to her after years of being an alcoholic. However, in actuality, it was Kilgrave and his mind control powers that forced Jack to give up his kidneys, while the doctor that was forced to perform the transplant was the one who donated the dialysis machine.

maurice canfield.name: Maurice Canfield
maurice canfield.origin: ===Origins=== The only son of an affluent black family, Maurice Canfield grew up fairly privileged in Philadelphia. As a young man, Maurice became very politically and socially active. After the United States was attacked at Pearl Harbor, Maurice became very outspoken against the U.S.’s involvement in World War II. Eventually, Maurice had charges brought against him for his protesting. Found guilty, Maurice was given the choice to either serve a prison sentence or enlist in the military. He chose to enlist. ===Super Soldier=== During basic training in Camp Cathcart, Mississippi, Maurice’s extremist communist views and beliefs drew attention both in his platoon and among others in the camp. After losing the secrets of the Super Soldier Serum with the death of Dr. Erskine, the United States Army still wanted to produce more Super Soldiers like Steve Rogers. Col. Walker Price and Dr. Wilfred Nagel forcibly recruited Maurice and 300 other Black soldiers to serve as test subjects to recreate the Super Soldier Serum. To keep the operation secret, families were sent letters informing them of the soldiers deaths. Stricken with grief, Mr. Canfield murdered his wife before committing suicide. left|thumb|200px|The Black Super Soldiers Of the 300 Black soldiers, only a handful of men survived the gruesome process. These survivors became a convert black ops team. After only a few missions, only Maurice, Isaiah Bradley and Sgt. Luke Evans remained. While waiting in Sintra, Portugal for the arrival of Captain America, Maurice discovered the truth about his parents' death. Enraged by the information, coupled with PTSD and an exaggerated thyroid gland, Maurice was led into a confrontation resulting in his death, the death of Sgt. Evans, and the severe injury of Isaiah and Pvt. Merritt.
abilities: Military Training: Maurice was trained in unarmed combat by the U.S. Army. College Education: Maurice was politically active and benefited from a college education.

maurice fortuit.name: Maurice Fortuit
maurice fortuit.origin: Maurice Destine was born in 1695 (or possibly the early 1600s). 200px|thumb|left|Maurice with Gracie Gamble (Earth-616)|Gracie, Adam, Flo, and Cuckoo in 1849 In 1849, Gracie, Adam, Flo, Cuckoo, and Maurice infiltrate The Guild and slew four Guild brothers. During his collection thousands precious artifacts by looting sites and stealing of indigenousness populations. This included paintings stolen during World War II, gems from the walls of the Taj Mahal, a statue from the Pyramids of Giza in Egypt, and items of Lagos. In 1969, Maurice attended Woodstock with his brothers Will, Newton, Sebastian, Dominic, and Vincent using Adam's VW van. In modern days, while snowbound in the female companionship Simone and Mimi, he was targeted by Lenz's agents, who were looking for the Gryphon. Despite his powers, Maurice was seemingly killed in the fight. His apparent death was witnessed by his brother Albert from his Seventh Moon Monastery in Nepal and via a clairvoyant dream by Flo at Ravenscroft Manor. However, Maurice faked his death and went into hiding adopting the guise of the reclusive Maurice Canton and moving into his countryside manor near Stonehenge in England. After hearing about Maurice Canton's refusal to return artifacts plundered during colonial occupations, Rogue and Gambit decided to travel to his estate in England to steal them back. After breaking into his home, the pair discovered a massive underground warehouse full of ancient artifacts. Despites Maurice's protestations, Rogue and Gambit returned the precious artifacts to their various home countries.
powers: Due to his magical heritage, Maurice possessed several powers including: : Maurice was able to generate some form of energy from his hands. : Like many other members of Clan Destine, he was also extremely long lived.
weaknesses: Maurice's hotheaded nature and impulsive anger were his greatest weakness.

maurice grauline.name: Maurice Grauline
maurice grauline.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 21
maurice grauline.origin: Maurice Grauline was a money launderer with dealings with Jonathan Lee, former embezzler and later accountant for Silver Sable International. When Lee embezzled a fortune from Sable, he used Grauline's services in the operation. After that, Grauline decided to go to Canada to avoid being persecuted. Grauline was kept informed of where Lee was. However, Sable sent her agent Paladin to find Lee. Following the trail, Paladin found Grauline in Toronto, and took him up to the CN Tower, threatening to throw him from there unless Grauline could give him useful information. Grauline quickly confessed where Lee was so Paladin could chase him.
abilities: Money laundering skills.

maurice poitain.name: Maurice Poitain
maurice poitain.origin: General Maurice Poitain was a man who had appropriated alien Nuwali technology that existed at a Quantum Nexus that could be calibrated to access any point in the material realm of any dimension. With it, Poitain spent two years in the Savage Land, clashing several times with Ka-Zar, but managing to accumulate enough Antarctic Vibranium to be able to mount a global-scale coup with his mercenary army, hoping to obtain his own regime on a planetary scale. He was stopped in his attempt by Thor and Phastos who had traveled to the Savage Land to obtain Vibranium themselves, and was finally defeated by Ka-Zar.

maw inferno baby.name: Maw (Inferno Baby)
maw inferno baby.origin: ===Inferno Babies=== Maw was one of the Inferno Babies used to open portals to Limbo. Using information from Cameron Hodge, Ten mutant children were kidnapped, by N'astirh's N'asteris, during the Inferno. The infants arrived in a cemetery, where the demon N'astirh was attempting to create a permanently open portal between the demon infested dimension of Limbo and Earth. The infants were teleported to Times Square, where the New Mutant Magik was opening a portal to return her teammates from Limbo, and N'astirh, using the babies as the points of an inverted pentagram (focusing beams of power because of their purity and openness to use them as natural, living conduits who could not block the flow of power and who would not know how to shut it off), kept the portal open. N'astirh attempted to used them, and baby Christopher Summers, who later grew-up to become Cable, to open a portal from Limbo to Earth, and was partially successful in merging the two realms. The X-Terminators and the New Mutants saved the children. After the defeat of N'astirh, the Goblin Queen attempted to sacrifice baby Christopher and the other nine mutant babies atop the Empire State Building, to finish N'astirh's work and permanently open a gateway between Earth and Limbo. The invasion was thwarted after the Goblin Queen committed suicide in combat with Marvel Girl, attempting to kill everyone in range of her power. After the X-Terminators and New Mutants took the babies to X-Factor's Celestial Ship, X-Factor turned the babies over to the US government, after being attacked by Nanny and Orphan-Maker. ===Project Purgatory=== For many years the fate of children remained unknown. Following the Inferno, the United States Army founded Project Purgatory to research the fields of the supernatural and paranormal. One of the recruited scientists, Doctor Noc, developed technology to use the children to open portals to Limbo. General Ulysses, Doctor Noc, and a trained band of military soldiers established a military base in Limbo, the Hatchery. At the base, they continued to experiment, both on demons and on the Inferno babies, and train new soldiers. However, when the soldiers recovered the Bloodstone amulet, the base was attacked by Witchfire and the Inferno babies were believed dead. The Earth based military forces sealed off the portal Epsilon, leaving those on the Limbo base stranded to find the observation portal with virtually no hope of escape. Trapped there, they were trained to hate the New Mutants. After 26 years in Limbo, but only 4 years on Earth, Noc and Ulysses were able to locate a traveling portal and return home, keeping the existence of the children to themselves. However, they never gave up their mission of taking control of Limbo and capturing Illyana Rasputin. They returned to a world where all of the mutants were living together, on Utopia. and, therefore, their commanding officer, General Combest, ordered them to stand-down. The unit still believed that Illyana was a significant threat and, after Project Purgatory kidnapped Pixie, the Inferno Babies revealed themselves when they killed General Combest and obliterated the entire battalion. The New Mutants showed up to rescue Pixie and the Inferno Babies defeated them. After Dr. Noc and General Ulysses took Illyana's Soulsword and Pixie's Souldagger, they extracted the Bloodstones and completed the Bloodstone Amulet to call forth the Elder Gods. They, along with members of Project Purgatory, tortured the New Mutants. While attempting to transport the New Mutants to Limbo, to be used as sacrifices for the Elder Gods, Karma showed Face what Project Purgatory had done to him and he killed Maw, Timothy, and members of Project Purgatory and freed Magik and Karma.
powers: Maw is a mutant with physically based powers: Extra Mouths: Maw has numerous extra mouths all over his body. It is unknown how or why these extra mouths develop or if they can be used to verbally communicate.

max bovar.name: Max Bovar
max bovar.origin: Max Bovar was a Gestapo agent for the Nazis during World War II. As a child, he grew up with Hans Dreden. Dreden eventually immigrated to the United States with his parents and grew up to be a chemist working for the Mars Powder Company, a company that developed new forms of gunpowder for the United States military following the outbreak of World War II. A high ranking Gestapo agent by that time, Max Bovar was sent to the United States in 1944 in order to force Dreden to provide the formula for his newest invention, Mars-X Powder. Bovar left a note telling Hans that he would meet him that night, unaware that his suspicious lurking around the neighborhood attracted the attention of the hero known as the Angel in the process. Breaking into Hans's home, he demanded the scientist to provide the formula. When Hans refused to betray his adopted country, Max ordered his men to grab Hans's wife Elsa and threatened to brand her with a swastika if he did not comply. Hans conceded and prepared to write out the formula when the Angle crashed in through the window. As the hero battled with Max's minions, Max himself attempted to flee the scene. The Angel tried to stop him, but Max broke free and tossed a grenade at the hero. Thinking the Angel was killed in the explosion, Max attempted to hail a cab to escape. The Angel however managed to survive and resuming his struggle with Max, pushed the Gestapo agent into the path of the speeding cab. Max was fatally struck down by the cab, ending his threat to the Dredens.
weapons: Max was armed with a pistol and carried grenades.

max brashear.name: Max Brashear
max brashear.origin: ===Origin=== Max Brashear was the second son of Adam Brashear, the Blue Marvel. After his brother was left stranded in the Neutral Zone following a battle against Dr. Skorpion, Max grew distant from his father, ultimately abandoning his family and asking not to be contacted ever again. ===Rescuing His Brother=== thumb|left|200px|Max Brashear Max started working for the terrorist organization W.E.S.P.E., under the identity of Doctor Positron, in order to fund his projects to open a portal to the Neutral Zone and bring his brother back. A short time later, Max lured Blue Marvel and the Mighty Avengers to his base on an island where he revealed his identity to his father and activated the portal to the Neutral Zone, but the dimensional feedback caused most of his headquarters to explode, revealing a giant hand emerging from the portal. Kevin started emerging from the portal hideously enlarged and distorted as Max attempted but failed to destabilize the portal. Blue Marvel realized the only way to save him was to push him back, for which She-Hulk attacked Kevin until he went inside the portal once more so it could be deactivated without any risk. Adam attempted to reason with Max, but he angrily insulted him and escaped. Weeks later, Max approached his father more calmly, after having gotten rough coordinates of Kevin's location within the Neutral Zone. Kevin communicated with him, warning him about the Beyond Corporation. When the Mighty Avengers confronted one of their avatars, Adam and Max worked together to reprogram the portal the Beyond Corporation used to enter reality and successfully bring back Kevin, who had been empowered by his exposure to the Neutral Zone. Kevin forced Beyond's agent back to the Neutral Zone, while disappearing as well in the process. Blue Marvel and Max soon set out to try to reach out to Kevin again. ===A.I.M.=== Max later joined the rebranded A.I.M., working for their Theoretical Physics Division. During his tenure working for A.I.M., Max befriended Víctor Álvarez, aka Power Man, a member of A.I.M.'s New Avengers team. When Víctor decided to leave A.I.M. and return to his home neighborhood, Max decided to follow him, having grown bored of his adventures with A.I.M.. He also suggested to use a new code name: Iron Fist.

max garr.name: Max Garr
max garr.origin: Nothing has been revealed about the early life of Max Garr. He worked as the foreman of an unnamed mine, running a tight ship and making sure his miners did not slack off. One day, the mine's owner, Mr. Kellen, called Garr into his office to show him the newest member of the mining crew: A large robot. Kellen said that the robot was a prototype, and hoped to have several in every mine pit. Garr believed that the robot had been brought in to replace him, and, after taking it into the mine, opened the robot's control panel and tampered with its wiring. Before Garr could exit the mine, a cave-in occurred, and Garr was trapped below the surface. Kellen called down to Garr through one of the mine's telephones and informed him that he was the only one left in the mine. As Garr panicked about being stuck, Kellen informed him about the robot's true function: It was designed to tunnel through debris in the case of a cave-in to save miners. Garr immediately began trying to reconnect the wires he had scrambled, but could not remember what he had changed. While Garr's fate is not revealed, that limited amount of oxygen in the mine most likely means he suffocated while trying to fix the robot.

max kalee.name: Max Kalee
max kalee.origin: Colonel Max Kalee was the leader of the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA), a rogue team in the United States military that was associated with corrupt U.S. Attorney General Roger Mollech in the conspiracy Project: Democracy. As a part of their work, the DIA oversaw illegal operations of arms trafficking in the United States, to ensure that they happen without any problem, as these operations were arranged by Mollech to provide the government of Medisuela with defective weapons that would blow up on their faces when they try to use them. Medisuelan President, General Navatilas, believed Mollech wanted him to use these weapons against other South American countries to favor U.S. interests, but Mollech really wanted the United States to invade Medisuela and replace Navatilas with a puppet government under his control, something that the DIA knew. The DIA oversaw an operation where gunrunner Doctor Slickster was to distribute a shipment of such weapons to Medisuelan forces in American soil. Superhero Captain America, hearing about an increase in weapon traffic, tracked the operation and stopped it, thou a rocket launcher exploded when a Medisuelan tried to use it. The DIA revealed their presence and Kalee claimed to have been tailing Slickster for months, offering to clean up the scene and send Captain America a report, revealing to him that the weapons were not for a domestic terrorist group as Captain America had feared, but for Medisuela. However, Kalee really impounded the weapons and load those on a military airplane crewed by Kalee and DIA Sergeant Lykaios Theopolous, and fly those to Medisuela themselves. Captain America, following the trail and finding out that the weapons had been sabotaged, checked on the government warehouses to find out that Kalee had personally taken the load, signing out a document. Captain America found the plane Kalee was flying, but Kalee refused to delay his trip to talk with Captain America. Captain America sneaked into the plane mid-flight, confirmed that the weapons had been manipulated, and left, not without Theopolous noticing him. Kalee and Theopolous reported to Mollech's aide Angela Stone, who ordered Kalee to finish the delivery then come back to discuss his blunder; she then recruited the Punisher to kill Captain America, then sent Theopolous to kill the Punisher. Kalee and the rest of the DIA joined Mollech and Stone on a boat trip where Mollech met with Navatilas in person; the DIA did not reveal their presence but argued that Navatilas was not really useful. Stone next took Kalee and DIA lieutenant Peter Malev on a field trip to the weapons delivery company, to check whether the Punisher had obtained information on the conspiracy. When clerk Ms White was not intimidated to reveal information to the Department of Justice, Stone murdered her, with Kalee and Malev helping her dispose of the corpse, and confirmed that the Punisher and Captain America were infiltrating in Medisuela, which she reported to her superiors. Mollech publicly accused Navatilas of ordering Captain America's assassination, using it as grounds for the invasion, but the U.S. Administration thwarted his attempts to declare a full-scale war. Undeterred, Mollech arranged for the DIA and his allies in the United States Air Force to covertly infiltrate Medisuela in uniform and assault the capital city, Medisuela City, trying to force the government to commit to a full-scale invasion lest they'd admit to have rogue elements in the military. Kalee and his DIA peers participated using attack helicopters and strafing civilians in the street, while Medisuelan anti-aircraft guns exploded in the gunners' face. However, Captain America and the Punisher joined the defense of the city. Kalee's chopper was downed, and Captain America confronted him on land, disgusted at Kalee's betrayal on America's moral principles. After some time, Captain America proved to be Kalee's superior in a fight but, when Captain America insisted that Kalee surrender and give him names of his accomplices, Kalee committed suicide with a lethal pill.
weapons: Guns

max kole.origin: Max Kole was a drummer for the Swinging Six who was envious of Taps another member of the band. While travelling through Romania he heard about a Grimm a local romani with magic. He visits her about improving his playing ability. At first, she refuses to help him because she can tell he is asking out of impure motives, but he threatens her with violence and so she casts her spell. At first, he is happy with his new fame as an excellent drummer, until he discovers that he can never stop drumming.

Together with his sister Zoe, Max created the Hearts 4 Hemophilia calendar, a project that has raised over U$S 7,000 to support the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia.

max lohmer.species: Human mutate, empowered with a variant of the Super-Soldier Serum
max lohmer.origin: Max Lohmer was a young, thuggish Neo-Nazi when he was approached by Aleksander Lukin (under the influence of the Red Skull). The Skull apparently enhanced Max Lohmer's body to where he had augmented strength and powers similar or identical to his great-uncle, the original Master Man. Max Lohmer led the criminal Neo-Nazi group Master Race but were opposed and eventually defeated by Captain America, Sharon Carter, Union Jack, Spitfire, and the Winter Soldier. Max Lohmer allied himself with other super-powered Nazis, Uber Commandos, and came into conflict with the Invaders. Interestingly enough, Max appears to have a fascination with his Great-Uncle's widow Warrior Woman, who has maintained her youthful appearance. This dalliance aside, Max has more recently sworn his undying loyalty and affection to the new Red Skull: Sin. Soon after joining Sin, he was sent to Exile Island to help The Exiles ambush Captain America, Sharon Carter, Maria Hill, and Victoria Hand. He then engaged Captain America in a fist fight outside the castle on the island. While they were fighting, Quake destroyed the castle, unaware of agents within. A segment of the wall fell on them, and while Captain America survived due to his shield protecting him, Master Man was crushed and killed.

max pressman.name: Max Pressman
max pressman.origin: Max Pressman had murdered his wife Maria and attempted to kill himself and his two small children, Michael and Melinda. A police officer shot and killed him before he could do so, but Pressman eventually returned as a ghost-like entity, with only the face of Melinda's doll as his own. He was called Wallow, able to induce and feed upon human misery. Approaching the now-adult Melinda, he stirred despair within her until she stepped from a ten-story building; however, she survived the fall, and Ghost Rider hurried her to a hospital. Wallow next pushed Michael off another rooftop, but he too survived, and Ghost Rider drove Wallow away. Learning of Wallow's crimes and intent, Ghost Rider rushed to Melinda's bedside and prevented Wallow from murdering her. Ghost Rider's penance stare somehow reduced Wallow's ghostly form to ashes, but his essence was drawn to Blackheart's realm.
powers: and : Wallow has the empathic ability to induce fear and misery, which he then feeds on.

max rocker.origin: Max Rocker is a mutant who met Alexander Flynn and Hugo Longride. Max met Dazzler and drugged her, causing her to lose control of her powers. This gave Rocker and Flynn, using his powers of hypnosis, to convince Dazzler to remain with the Gladiators rather than leave with Beast. In truth, Flynn planned on invading Latveria, and after capturing Beast and Dazzler, Flynn, Rocker, and other Gladiators taunted the two about their plans. Dazzler tried to convince Max to stop Flynn, but he could not do anything then. Flynn wanted the create an army of mutant warriors through survival of the fittest. Rocker felt this was a bit too much like Hitler's idea of a master race and tried to get fellow Gladiator Ivich to oppose Flynn with him. Max then released Beast and Dazzler, and got the assistance of the Heartbreak Hotel mutants Poltergeist and Link. After defeating Flynn, Rocker wanted to continue the Gladiators without death matches and was joined by Ivich and the other Gladiators. Later, Max Rocker and the other Gladiators fought against the New Mutants under the control of the Shadow King. Max Rocker's subsequent fate and whether or not he kept his mutant powers after the events of M-Day have yet to be revealed.
powers: Equestrienne Appearance: Rocker possesses the hooves, the main and the general appearance of a horse.

max silk.name: Max Silk
max silk.origin: Max Silk was an ex-lawyer who became a heroin dealer and one of New York City's biggest drug dealers, whose organization never had any trouble with the Punisher. When the Punisher accidentally slaughtered an innocent family, he lost it. The Kingpin convinced him to go out in a blaze of glory, providing him with information on his competitors, who the Punisher would never have learned about otherwise. As the Punisher began taking out the city's major players in the drug trade, Max Silk headed out to New Jersey with two cars escorting his limo. The Punisher hit the convoy on a bridge out of NY City, ramming them off the bridge and into the sea.

max stryker.name: Max Stryker
max stryker.species: Human mutated by gamma ray exposure
max stryker.origin: Max Stryker was a criminal mob boss that dominated the New York underworld before the modern age of super-heroes. By his own accord, Max claimed to have mentored the Kingpin, though there is no official record indicating such a claim as fact. Years after Max retired as the "King of Crime", his health began to deteriorate. He developed advanced stages of cancer and was confined to a wheelchair. Desperate to prolong his life, Max researched modern advances in medicine and learned about Dr. Bruce Banner's recent invention of the Gammascope – a device that siphoned raw gamma radiation from the heavens and could potentially heal diseased blood cells. Stryker knew that Banner would never willfully test his process on a known felon, so he sought alternative measures to insure Banner's cooperation. left|thumb|Max Stryker Max arranged for the mercenary known as Boomerang to be released from prison. He sent Boomerang to Banner's laboratory retreat, Northwind Observatory, with instructions to kidnap Banner's paramour, Kate Waynesboro. Boomerang did as instructed, and managed to bring Waynesboro to one of Max's safe houses. Stryker arrived at Northwind Observatory and blackmailed Banner into using the Gammascope to heal Max's broken body. Max became the Gammascope's first human test subject. Bruce performed the process, and it appeared to work perfectly. Max Stryker was healed, but his skin turned light green as a harmless side effect. The Hulk left Max to rescue Kate Waynesboro, but the cosmic entity known as the Beyonder interrupted the journey, spiriting the Hulk away to another world to participate in his "Secret Wars". With the Hulk absent, Stryker had complete access to all of Banner's equipment. He was so overwhelmed with his renewed health however, that rather than steal Banner’s work, he began using the Gammascope to heal the sick and dying masses. When the Hulk eventually returned from the Secret Wars, he was enraged that Stryker would use such an untested process on innocent people. Banner's fury was augmented by the fact that he was slowly losing control over his Hulk persona. Banner and Stryker both learned, too late, that the Gammascope process yielded more devastating long term results. Stryker transformed into a brutish mockery of his former self, with power equitable to that of the Hulk himself. The two monsters fought one another, and the Hulk gave in to his darker fury, nearly beating Max Stryker to death. The Galadorian spaceknight, Rom, arrived on the scene suspecting to find Dire Wraith activity in the area. At the behest of Kate Waynesboro, Rom used his Neutralizer ray to burn out the gamma cells in Max's body. Fortunately, Max's exposure to gamma radiation had been so recent, that not enough time had passed for it to permanently alter his genetic structure. Healed of the Gammascope's effects, Max Stryker reverted to his previous infirm condition.
powers: Exposure to Bruce Banner's Gammascope enhanced Max's strength, speed and stamina to superhuman levels.
weaknesses: In recent years, Max's health has suffered serious decline, and he has been confined to a wheelchair.

maxam.name: Maxam
maxam.first_appearance: Warlock and the Infinity Watch Vol 1 12
maxam.origin: Maxam was a time traveler from a future when Adam Warlock's evil self, the Magus, had conquered the universe. Maxam and his childhood friend Zhang were cared for by a Badoon named Master Ecclaw. Maxam was chosen to be the sent back into the past to destroy the Magus' "larval stage" of Adam Warlock. However, Maxam lost his memories as soon as he arrived in the past. He was found amnesiac on the shore of Monster Isle, where the Infinity Watch resided. Maxam joined the Infinity Watch soon afterwards, but did not have an Infinity Gem as the other members did. Moondragon, even with the Mind Gem at her disposal, was incapable of reading Maxam's thoughts, which caused Gamora, who had previously seen Maxam killing Adam Warlock in a vision given to her by the Time Gem, to harbor misgivings about him. Maxam proved himself to be a trustworthy member of the group and helped the team in many battles against foes such as Count Abyss, Thor (after he was struck by the Warrior Madness); and during the Infinity Crusade. thumb|left|Maxam vs. Hercules After Moondragon was critically injured, the Infinity Watch met to decide the fate of the Mind Gem. Maxam offered to take the gem but Gamora was adamant about him not being entrusted with the gem. After making a comment about Gamora's love for Adam Warlock, Maxam was attacked by Gamora, who tried to kill him. Gamora begged Adam Warlock to have faith in her and that Maxam was not to be trusted, but Adam refused to see her side of things, prompting Gamora to quit the Infinity Watch. Later that night, Maxam placed the Time Gem, which Gamora had thrown at Adam Warlock earlier, upon his brow and regained his lost memories. Maxam ambushed Adam and they fought. Maxam was finally defeated by Moondragon using her mental powers to give Maxam the hallucination that he had slain Adam Warlock in battle. With his mission seemingly completed, Maxam teleported back to his own timeline never to be seen again.
abilities: Hand-to-Hand Combat: Maxam is normally a fair warrior. However, he can be pushed into a savage, frenzied state in which he is virtually unstoppable. Learned Intellect: He is also familiar with sophisticated technology.
weapons: Owner of the Time Gem for a brief period of time, which unlocked his memories.

maxie muggs.name: Maxie Muggs
maxie muggs.origin: Maxie Muggs was a big time criminal who the law could not touch. One day in the spring of 1943, he happened to meet young Celia Fisher. She told him of her father, Doctor Weldon Fisher, who was experimenting in guinea pigs to try and learn how to cheat death. Muggs was interested in the idea, and after learning that tests on the guinea pigs worked, he blackmailed the Fishers into working for him and stepped up to human testing. The test subjects were all members of Muggs gang, some early subjects were killed or maimed. Among them was Limpy Marcus. Eventually, Dr. Fisher perfected his invention to work on humans, and Maxie underwent the procedure. Unaware of this, Limpy Marcus tipped the police off that Muggs was going to be hanging out at the Grove Tavern. When the police arrived to arrest him, he was shot and pretended to be dead while fleeing the authorities. When he was left alone in the morgue, Muggs got up and left, strangling the night janitor when he was discovered. Knowing that Limpy had ratted him out, Maxie then sent his men to eliminate him, but at this point, Limpy had sought protection from the Angel who stopped the gun man sent to kill Marcus. The gun man committed suicide, but the Angel found Doctor Fisher's business card and paid him a visit. After Dr. Fisher explained everything to the Angel, Maxie Muggs and his gang arrived and took them all hostage. He then had the Angel strapped into the device to electrocute him. However, Limpy Marcus arrived with a machine gun and mowed down all of Muggs's men. He then began shooting Muggs, who fled in pain. In his panic, he tripped and landed on one of the dynamos that powered the Doctor's machine. The resulting electrical surge undid the effects of the immortality process, and Muggs was electrocuted to death. Following Muggs's death, Doctor Fisher decided to destroy his creation, finding it too dangerous for mankind to possess.

maxie murdock.name: Maxie Murdock
maxie murdock.origin: Maxie Murdock was a gang leader who was active in the 1940s. In the fall of 1944, he worked on a synchronized plot to simultaneously rob a local jewelry shop and art gallery. Seeing the super-speedster known as the Whizzer as a problem, Murdock planned to have the robberies happen just seconds after a phony robbery of a bank. Since all three locations where in different parts of the city, Murdock believed that the Whizzer could not stop all three crimes. Sending one of his men to commit the bank robbery, Murdock -- taking the nom de plume of the "Crime Clocker" -- gave his minion a letter detailing his plot to mock the Whizzer when he caught the would-be bank robbery. Murdock did not anticipate that the Whizzer would be able to beat the location of the other two crimes out of his minion and stop them. The Whizzer foiled the jewelry store robbery and then allowed the art thieves to escape so that he could be led to their employer's hideout. Leading the Whizzer right to Murdock's mansion led to the downfall of the Crime Clocker, with the Whizzer easily trouncing Murdock and his men and turning them over to the authorities. Murdock's subsequent activities are unknown.

maxie stein.name: Maxie Stein
maxie stein.origin: Maxie Stein was apart of the group known as the Victory Boys. Their first known operation, Maxie helped to save the father of Victor, an American boy who later joined their team. . After that, when the group became hungry in the Black Forest, they chose in a stick-pull who should go hunt for a meal, and Maxie got the longest stick, so he had to go and catch a deer. Later, he approached a group of Nazis who were hunting a deer for the Emperor of Japan. When the boy met the group, he shot an arrow for the others in case the Nazis capture him. Then for the second shot he got the deer. Quickly, the Nazis had seen the victory sign in his pocket, so they knocked him out and made him a prisoner. The Victory Boys found his mark and quickly they freed him by making emperor Hirohito their captive. After Maxie got out of abduction, the group had a feast and fled from the Nazi group.

maxie the rodent.name: Maxie the Rodent
maxie the rodent.origin: Maxie the Rodent was a human and narcotics smuggler that operated out of the town of Middleton. When the authorities were getting wise to his operations, thanks to their informant Walter Carstairs, an agent from the FBI, Maxie faked his own death - he eliminated Walter and took his place to lure the police into a trap. Officer Pat Murphy found Maxie's face familiar and decided to develop the false identity of Chauncey Throttlebottom III - the Vagabond - to get close enough to discover his identity. As Maxie lead two officers into a trap, the Vagabond earned his place in the smuggling operation as hired muscle. When Maxie attempted to eliminate the police, the Vagabond beat Maxie and his minions into submission and left them to the authorities. Maxie the Rodent may be a minor crook in the grand scheme of things, but his activities led to the birth of one of the most obscure heroes of World War II, the Vagabond.
weapons: Maxie carried a pistol.

maxim dreer.name: Maxim Dreer
maxim dreer.species: Human whose brain was transplanted into a Robot
maxim dreer.origin: thumb|left|105px|Maxim Dreer's human body Maxim Dreer was a scientist who was active in the 1940s. Discredited from legitimate profession by the winter of 1942, Dreer began private experiments with his assistant, Grettle, in his private home. He was attempting to find a way to do a complete head transplant, starting by transplanting the heads of animals onto the bodies of homeless people. When his experiments were failures, he dumped the bodies outside his home. These horrors were discovered by the local townspeople who stormed his home and carried him outside. In an almost ironic twist, they tried to teach Dreer the sanctity of life by tossing him off a cliff to his death. His body was recovered by Grettle, who succeeded in transplanting Dreer's brain into a robot body. Revived, Dreer was horrified by what he became and strangled his assistant Grettle to death. He then stormed into the village and began killing the villagers he held responsible for his demise. He was confronted by the Vision who attempted to stop his murder spree. Dreer knocked the hero out and carried him back to his home where he prepared to complete a head transplant to place his head on the body of the Vision. The Vision came around and attacked Dreer with live wires from one of his machines. The heat from the electricity caused Dreer's body to melt and the hot metal set fire to the chemicals in the house, causing a massive explosion that destroyed Dreer's robotic body and human brain.

The Vision came around and attacked Dreer with live wires from one of his machines. The heat from the electricity caused Dreer's body to melt and the hot metal set fire to the chemicals in the house, causing a massive explosion that destroyed Dreer's robotic body and human brain.

maxime.name: Maxime
maxime.origin: ===Origin=== The parents of Maxime and his twin sister, Manon, were both mutants, and because of this, the twins' powers manifested earlier than usual, so they joined Xavier Institute before puberty. At some point thereafter they were visited by Jean Grey and told her how their powers worked. ===Extermination=== Five years later the twins were kidnapped and brainwashed by Ahab to create new Hounds for him. Ahab then brought the twins from their time to present day to infiltrate the X-Men. As planned, they were discovered and "rescued" by the X-Men from a mob of anti-mutant protesters. After arriving in the Xavier Institute, Maxime and Manon transformed several X-Men into Hounds before they all escaped with Ahab. During the battle in X-Lantis, Maxime and Manon turned even more X-Men into Hounds, but eventually, thanks to the memory transfer from her younger version, Jean Grey learned how to defeat them and freed everyone from the twins' influence. Cable then asked Jean to take care of the twins, because they were good children before Ahab's interference, and now they needed a new home. ===Age of X-Man=== Maxime was among the mutants trapped in the Age of X-Man pocket reality, where his memories were altered. There, Maxime was a student at the Summers Institute for Higher Learning in the Civil Management Division. He and Manon were teasing Glob Herman about him not having real friends except for the three chickens that he took care of. Maxime called them the X-Hens. He and his sister were then scolded by Armor to leave Glob alone or she would report them to Dean Angel. ===Dawn of X=== Maxime moved to Krakoa along with the majority of Earth's mutants. He and his sister saw Armor and Glob leaving to visit their friends Beak and Angel Salvadore in Nebraska and and offered to use their powers to make Beak and Angel want to come to Krakoa. Armor told them not to use their powers on their friends but allowed them to come along. During the visit, the group is attacked by anti-mutant extremists and held hostage for Krakoan medicines. The group is held captive for days using inhibitor collars but manage to free Maxime and Manon, and both use their powers to convince one of their captors to try to kill his friend. Despite questioning their methods, Glob manages to free the rest of the captives due to the distraction.

maximilian stone.name: Maximilian Stone
maximilian stone.species: Human merged with an intelligent magma entity
maximilian stone.origin: thumb|left|As Maximillian Stone An intelligent magma entity was drawn to near the surface by Ultimo moving beneath the continental plates. When Ultimo began to smash his way to the surface, the forces involved caused the Mount Acheron Geothermal Research Facility (an experimental power station financed by Stark Enterprises) drilling rig began to go out of control. Doctor Maximilian Stone ordered the station evacuated and remained behind to shut down the power station. At this time, Ultimo moved again and caused a crack to appear beneath Doctor Stone, who fell into the molten lava. Under normal circumstances, he would have died. The magma entity sensed his presence and wrapped him in a protective cocoon of stone. However, because the surface of the lava was too cold (comparatively) for the magma entity, it was dying too. Because they were physically connected, they became aware of each other's thoughts and shared their respective stories. Then the magma entity proposed a way they could both survive. By merging together, they could become a singular lifeform that could survive in either of their natural environments. Doctor Stone agreed and they merged together. When Earth Mover emerged from his stone cocoon, he assumed the power station was responsible for the geological instability and set out to destroy it. Meanwhile, Ted Kinderman (who also worked at the power station) contacted Tony Stark and reported Doctor Stone's disappearance. Acting quickly, Tony sent a remote controlled armor to rescue Doctor Stone. When he reached the last known place where Doctor Stone was assumed to be, he met Earth Mover. Since Earth Mover hadn't yet learned to speak is his new form, his attempts to warn Iron Man to leave were assumed to be a threat (it sounded like magma roaring). Consequently, Iron Man attempted to fight Earth Mover and was defeated. When Ultimo began his final push towards the surface, Earth Mover realized the real cause of the geological instability, especially when Ultimo surfaced. Earth Mover and Iron Man then turned to fight their common enemy. Earth Mover was apparently vaporized by Ultimo's eye beams. However, given his special powers (See Powers), it cannot be assumed this resulted in his demise.
abilities: Earth Mover has all of Doctor Stone's knowledge. So, he is a genius in geophysics and has detailed knowledge of power generating technology relating to the Mount Acheron Facilty.

maximus lobo.name: Maximus Lobo
maximus lobo.origin: Maximus Lobo was part of a new breed of mutants that bore a striking resemblance to werewolves. He ran the company Lobo Technologies, which was a division of Worthington Industries and owned by the veteran X-Man Archangel. In White Plains, New York, where Lobo Technologies was located, Maximus Lobo and more of his kind, the self-fashioned Dominant Species, slaughtered a small group of humans, but spared the mutant girl who was present. When a team of X-Men went to investigate this murder, Lobo fought and defeated Wolverine in a relatively short time. Lobo and the others then engaged the rest of the X-Men there and forced them to retreat. Lobo and his pack caught up to Archangel and Husk, and tried to kill them off. There, he claimed to have killed Archangel's father. Lobo and his werewolves pursued the two mutants back to Lobo Technologies, where it was revealed that Lobo was planning to illegally see Stark Enterprises under Archangel's name. When the rest of the X-Men arrived to help Archangel and Husk, Lobo created an explosion to cover his escape. Lobo and the Dominant Species later returned when the dimension-hopping Exiles teamed up with the X-Men to battle an alternate reality version of Havok. Lobo sought to sway the young lupine mutant named Nicholas Gleason to his cause. Maximus lost his mutant powers after M-Day and was briefly threatened by a vengeful Nicholas Gleason after the events of Messiah Complex.

maxine danger.name: Maxine Danger
maxine danger.origin: Maxine Danger was the head of the Super Hero Development Department for the Beyond Corporation working out of the Beyond Tower in New York City. As such, she oversaw the enlistment of Peter Parker's clone Ben Reilly into becoming Beyond's own corporate-sponsored Spider-Man. While the Super Hero Development Department helped Beyond gain a positive foothold in the perception of the public, its secret ultimate purpose was to work in tandem with a super villain division to orchestrate conflicts whose collateral damage could be used to wipe out any desired targets. Maxine met and held a private conversation with Ben when hearing doubts of his performance by her colleague, Marcus Momplaisir. When voicing those doubts and talking with Ben, she was pleased when he alleviated her worries about his performance and wished him well in his therapy session with Dr. Ashley Kafka. After Ben's unsuccessful attempt to catch Morbius, Maxine asked the doctor about the consequences of letting the vampirism go unchecked in Ben's blood. When the doctor responded how pondering was unethical, Maxine ordered the doctor to administer the antitoxin, and exited the med-bay. Shortly after, she assigned Hero Department agents Misty Knight and Colleen Wing to subdue a new threat in Obsidian Star. However, the given capture technology led to a solid-hologram space, and while it was a golden testing opportunity, communications went down shortly after the two heroines used an anti-matter grenade. Upon their return, Maxine debriefed them to know what happened and was disappointed that Obsidian Star's power source wasn't delivered. But as they note her voice and the legality of her "disciplining them" could backfire, she was forced to save face and grant them some days off. Following Ben's abduction by Kraven, Maxine called Marcus for answers, reiterating her authority over him. With Ben returned, she was whelmed by his recovery status and resumed talks with lawyers on a lawsuit against the Brooklyn Spider-Man. After Ben defeated new villain Rhizome, Maxine was annoyed he failed to enforce Beyond's copyright to the super hero name and placed Marcus on disciplinary action. She finished her lecture with Ben before returning to a watch room, learning of Doc Ock's investigation into them, readying a sample of Rhizome in planned counter-measure. With Doc Ock's siege of the Beyond Midtown branch and Spider-Man's failure to stop him, Maxine elaborated that the data drive contained ultra-sensitive information for Beyond. As Doc Ock attacked Beyond Tower, Ben fought him and claimed to have destroyed the drive in the skirmish, but Maxine found he was lying when spying on his therapy session. Before he could divulge sensitive details, Maxine deployed security measures and took him for memory editing. After a touch-and-go memory edit, Maxine lied to Ben that Janine left him, then successfully petitioned the Beyond board to create new super villain, Queen Goblin, by merging Ashley Kafka with the captured sins of Norman Osborn. Equiping surveillance on the Goblin gear and directing her new villain to the Daily Bugle to stop a whistleblowing Janine, the drive was destroyed in the fight with Spider-Man. Expecting a further battle, Maxine was stunned that Ben just abandoned the fight; Ben's morality had been compromised by Beyond's memory-tampering, which he had become aware of. Seeing that the original Spider-Man returned to best Queen Goblin, Maxine demanded eyes on Ben and was unnerved to learn that Ben was heading to Beyond's Staten Island super villain facility, sending a widespread red alert across Beyond frequencies. Ben freed a monster called Creature Z from the Staten Island facility to cause a distraction while he went after Maxine at the Beyond Tower to figure a way to reclaim his lost memories. Danger activated Beyond's contingency measures to destroy evidence of her work and a portion of the building, and evacuated. When Ben stormed the tower, she used a holographic decoy to communicate with him, coaxing him into trying to use the memory-extracting device on the original Spider-Man to take back his memories from their source. She then used another decoy to convene with her superiors, which saved her life from an execution attempt, after which she bid farewell to her former employers.
weaknesses: Sociopathy: According to Maxine, she took an experimental pharmaceutical for a mind-altering vision quest. The resulting experience led to her feeling guiltless with a high functioning sociopathy.

maxine sands.name: Maxine Sands
maxine sands.origin: Born from an illegal union, Maxine was a decred, with no legal existence, and refused access to services such as malls, hospitals, schools. She developed then an hatred to citizens, especially riches people carrying gold- or platinum-cards. At twelve, she wins the illegal competition known as Blue Dagger Championship and keep for five years the Blue Dagger, a Jet Blade and the trophy of the competition. At one point, she joined or fund the Young Blades gang, specialized into the murder of carders and the collection of their Credit I.D. implants. She killed at least nine of them, including three Public Eye subscribers. When her gang crossed the way of Jake Gallows, he was first shattered by the Public Eye's agent, and then by the Punisher himself. Killing all his friends, Jake confronted Maxine. Blue Max try to explain her reasons, but the Punisher was thinking only about punishment. Claiming nobody has ever give her nothing, she prefer suicide instead of allow the Punisher to give her death. Jake feels uncomfortable about her suicide, knowing that Maxine was not the only responsible for her behavior, but the product of her society. She was saved by her fellow Blade, Sky Boy, who was later captured and killed by the Punisher. Later, battling again for the Blue Dagger, she confronted the Punisher, and teaming-up with the Samurai, tried to kill him and win the race. Her comrade was killed, the Blue Dagger destroyed but she already win against the Punisher who wanted to beat Max to protect the children from the attractive reputation of this sport. Jake tried to kill her when she go out, but the spectators stand in front of him. Maxine then leaves. Jake swears to kill her the next time their path crossed but this encounter never came.
abilities: Jet Blade skilled driver and accomplished hand-to-hand and knife fighter.
weapons: Knife

maxmelle.name: Maxmelle
maxmelle.origin: Maxmelle was a Valusian knight whose life was inadvertently saved by the boy Sedrick, so he took him to the City of Wonders as his new squire. Sedrick then betrayed Valusia and Maxmelle who had trusted him, by using his shepherd's staff, enchanted by Thulsa Doom, to summon Beast-Men into the throneroom. Attempting to escape, Sedrick ran into Maxmelle and sobbed out the whole story. Maxmelle rushed off to defend his king and died in the battle. Ten thousand years later, Maxmelle, now known as the Footslave of the Elder Gods, was lured by the Devourer of Souls while wandering an ancient cavern deep beneath the earth under an inland sea. Conan met him in an underground cave in Koth, and took his Staff of the Elder Gods to use it against Xuthl's Shedu.

maxwell plumm.name: Maxwell Plumm
maxwell plumm.origin: Maxwell Plumm was a building contractor in New York City. He was indebted with crime boss Dominic Varone. To pay his debts, he was forced to perform budget cuts in his projects (including sub-standard materials and security practices), which caused different security failures. Of course, he kept it as a secret to his employees. Eventually, two of his construction workers fell to their deaths due to a sudden wind slipping the cable of a girder. A surviving worker was Jake Mallard, brother of the two victims. Mallard discovered Plumm's illicit activities and swore to get revenge on him. He made some construction-tool-like weapons and used a secret identity as the Steeplejack. The Steeplejack tried to kill Plumm by throwing him from the top of one of his buildings. However, Power Man was coincidentally near the area, witnessing the scene, and rushed to save Plumm. After exchanging some punches, the Steeplejack threw Plumm from the building, and Power Man had to save him. Plumm was knocked down because of the fight. However, when the police arrived (and the Steeplejack was long gone), Plumm awoke and hired Power Man as bodyguard. He did not explain Power Man the motivations of Steeplejack - although Steeplejack himself would. During a second fight with Power Man, Steeplejack used advanced weaponry but was nevertheless defeated and killed. However, Plumm noticed the Steeplejack's gear and found it interesting, so he salvaged and reproduced it; he wanted to patent and sell Mallard's inventions. He relocated to Boston, he also began a new project, Monarch Plaza, and continued his budget-cutting tactics. This new project involved a worker named Joseph Danvers, who was the father of super-heroine Ms. Marvel (Carol Danvers). Due to Plumm's illicit activities, Danvers was almost killed by the impact of materials thrown by a wind - and he would have died if his daughter were not there to save his life. Joe Danvers threatened Plumm because of the event, but Plumm counter-threatened Danvers. Danvers, suspicious of Plumm, decided to investigate him and asked his friends from NOW Magazine to research about his past. Through this means, Danvers discovered Plumm's debts with organized crime and his budget cuts. She reported him to the authorities. Meanwhile, Plumm disguised as the second Steeplejack. He had a slighter build than Mallard, and thus he could fool no one pretending to be the original Steeplejack. However, he designed a completely-different costume, and other weaponry. He used it to kidnap Joe Danvers and intended to throw him from the Monarch Plaza. He was unaware of Ms. Marvel's seventh sense, that alerted her. Ms. Marvel flew to rescue his father, but was forced to knock Joe down to stop Joe from fighting the Steeplejack. Ms. Marvel had read about the original Steeplejack and recognized the weapons, but she probably never saw any picture, because she thought Plumm was the first Steeplejack. Soon she noticed that Plumm did not speak like school-dropout Mallard, and that he had a firstly-unseen padded costume. She then discovered the Steeplejack's secret identity. The Steeplejack tried to slam Ms. Marvel to an elevator he had filled with dynamite, and then cut the cable. However, Ms. Marvel simply flew back to the battle. The Steeplejack tried rapid-succession fire, and due to this he sent debris towards the dynamite. He caused an explosion that levelled the building and stunned him enough to be captured by Ms. Marvel. Plumm probably went to jail after that, but he eventually escaped or was freed. He was then contacted by Gary Gilbert, a former customed criminal turned into business agent for criminals. Gilbert was worried about the Scourge of the Underworld, a masked figure who was killing customed criminals such as Gilbert and Plumm. Gilbert organized a meeting in the Bar with No Name, Medina County, Ohio, to discuss potential counter-attacks. As the Scourge was known to use weapons instead of powers, weapons were to be left at the door - even although the Steeplejack protested at this. However, the Scourge infiltrated the meeting disguised as the bartender and shot down all seventeen criminals (including Plumm) wielding a cut-down .50 submachine gun in each hand.
weapons: A rivet gun that could also fire several forms of energy and force (including light and heat), red-hot rivets, and a cable.

maya jackson.name: Maya Jackson
maya jackson.origin: Maya Jackson was a mutant whose powers developed faster compared to most people of her species. By the age of ten, she already possessed the ability to see through solid objects. Ever since she was little, Maya loved super heroes, and always wanted to be one. She was especially a big fan of Storm, to the point she collected any kind of pictures of Storm, and closely followed her personal life. When the M-Pox crisis broke out, Maya was visited by Iceman and Magik of the X-Men at her family's home in Philadelphia, and she was offered the chance to move to the safe zone of X-Haven in Limbo. Maya's mother refused to leave her home, so the X-Men left her a communicator in case they changed their mind. Maya later fell ill to M-Pox, and when their neighbors discovered she was a mutant, they decided to leave for X-Haven. Even though she was ill, Maya saw a silver lining in going to X-Haven, believing that she was going to meet her idol and become an X-Man. Unfortunately, Maya's condition had worsened to the point not even mutant healers could help her, and the X-Men were so busy Storm could never find time to be introduced to Maya. On her deathbed, Maya's sister, Alisha, rushed to try and get Storm to meet Maya. She was successful, and Storm talked with her. A few moments before she died, Maya was officially made a member of the X-Men under the alias she had created for herself, Lucid.

maynard murrel.name: Maynard Murrel
maynard murrel.origin: Maynard Murrel was a ruthless and notorious killer of the American Frontier, a man remembered in the town of Leadville, Texas as a man who was killed twice. When he was initially apprehended for murder he was tried and sentenced to death by hanging by Judge Elmer Higgins and a jury of his peers. Murrel was hung and seemingly killed, but unknown to all he only suffered a broken neck and pretended to be dead. When his body was to be buried, Murrel revealed that he was still alive to the graveyard groundskeeper threatening to kill him if he ever told anyone and disappeared into the night. Taking the threat seriously the groundskeeper buried an empty coffin and told nobody what he knew. Five years later, Murrel came back to Leadville to get revenge against those who sentenced him to death. Killing Ben Owen, one of the jurors who sentenced him and leaving a black gauntlet style glove at the murder scene. The killing alerted the interest of the masked hero known as the Black Rider and his friend, local rancher Jim Lathrop. Both made the Murrel connection and went to see Judge Higgins, but both arrived too late as Maynard had just murdered him leaving his trademark black glove at the scene. Murrel became more bold in his attacks, next appearing at the Golden Angel Saloon with a bomb intending to blow everyone up in the bar. However he was stopped by the Black Rider who wrestled the bomb from his hands and tossed it outside where it blew up safely, but in the confusion Murrel managed to escape. When the Black Rider and Lathrop went to Murrel's grave and dug up his coffin they found that it was empty. Murrel tried to gun them down, but fled when the Black Rider proved to be too much of a crack shot for him. He then appeared at the home of the caretaker for the graveyard just as the man finished telling the Black Rider and Lathrop what he knew. Although Murrel got the drop on the three men, the Black Rider proved to be a faster draw and shot Murrel dead. Murrel's corpse was buried in the the grave that had stood empty for him for the past five years.
abilities: Skilled shooter
weapons: Murrel carried two six guns and had access to bombs.

mayor allen.name: Mayor Allen
mayor allen.origin: Steve Rogers is on K.P. Duty when James Buchanan Barnes comes to him with a note delivered by the Axis agent known as the Vulture. It warns that he will kidnap Mayor Allen and warns that if Captain America should try to stop him, the star-spangled hero would be killed. When they are caught by Sgt. Duffy they are assigned to floor cleaning duty. Once finished his task, Steve and James change into Captain America and Bucky to go and watch the mayor. Captain America and Bucky spend the entire night waiting in the lobby of the mayor's apartment building waiting for the Vulture. When it appears that he hasn't shown, they go up to the mayor's penthouse apartment and are shocked to find him missing from his bedroom .

mayr.name: Mayr
mayr.origin: Mayr was one of the soldiers who served Umar. Mayr and another soldier were standing guard outside the entrance to the palace royale when a group of Outcasts approached. Mayr read the scroll that the mute Outcasts presented to him and was shocked to see that they had captured Umar's enemy, Doctor Strange. Realizing how they could benefit, Mayr and his fellow guard eagerly took custody of the bound Strange but only seconds later the G'uranthic Guardian revealed that Strange's bonds were only an illusion. Strange took advantage of their surprise to blast them into unconsciousness before they could sound the alarm.

mayzen.name: Mayzen
mayzen.origin: Mayzen the Poetic was a grim one among the Ice Elves of Alfheim, and was even known as Mayzen the Brooding One. His mother died giving birth to him, and his father hated him, at the point that Mayzen spat on his grave after his death. He seemingly used to watch at his brethren and despise their joy, but was attracted to Elphane. One day, Elphane managed to force him to join them. That day, blood rained over Alfheim, and the Ano-Athox arrived, Thane killing Elphane and Mayzen in a single sword stroke.

mazerot.name: Mazerot
mazerot.origin: Lady Mazerot belonged to the Black Bile Clan, which were known as the lords of the Wild Hunt for their use of war dogs. She was married and had 13 sons, but her husband and 12 of her sons were killed in the many wars fought by the Dark Elves during the reign of Kraw the Uncontrollable. Her last surviving son was Malekith, and she assured the boy that he will not have to die as a soldier. During the Forty-Third Troll War, Mazerot sold Malekith to the undertaker Elves of the Southern Swamps, in exchange for food for her war dogs. As Malekith was taken away, Mazerot told him that she could not lose another son without gaining nothing for it. She consoled him that at least he would not have to be a soldier. Many years later, Malekith returned home. As he revealed herself, Mazerot tried to excuse herself for her wrongdoing. Malekith had his mother fed to her own dogs, then took the mantle of the Lord of the Wild Hunt.

family: Malekith (son, deceased) Twelve other unnamed sons (deceased)

mcgool.name: McGool
mcgool.origin: Not much is known about the man called Boss McGool. His actual occupation is unknown however he was responsible for purchasing meat for a Christmas dinner being prepared for local orphans. McGool bought the cheapest meat available and pocketed the rest of the money. When the poor quality meat caused the orphans to get sick, it raised the ire of the super-hero known as Moon Man who correctly suspected that McGool purchased bad meat. After terrorizing both McGool and his secretary, Moon Man coerced McGool's secretary into providing a confession. McGool, fearing incarceration, attempted to flee town by train. However, Moon Man tracked him down and turned him over to the authorities.
weapons: McGool owned a handgun.

mcm xli.name: MCM-XLI
mcm xli.origin: MCM-XLI was one of a group of four space explorers who later assumed the names of Donar, Froh and Loga. MCM-XLI herself became known as Brunnhilde. Brunnhilde was the navigator of the nebula-cruiser known as the Tekeli-Li and was in command of a powerful artifact known as the Ring of the Nebulas. In December of 1941, Brunnhilde's ship crashed behind the Siegfried Line in Northern France, where it was soon discovered by a Nazi scientist named Werner Schmidt. Schmidt, better known as "Brain Drain", recovered the aliens and used the intense power of the Ring of the Nebulas to bend them to their will. Brunnhilde however, proved more willful than her male comrades and escaped from Brain Drain's clutches. She was present during a Nazi bombing in Paris, and although she survived. During the battle she returned to the trance state imposed by Brain Drain and was ordered to return to the base, the trance this time was so deep that she went to a tunnel destroyed by the bombings until Captain America rescued her from possible death by removing her the ring and return it to its usual state. However, she emerged from the wreckage with no knowledge of who she truly was. Brunnhilde met Captain America, who became instantly infatuated with her, and pledged to help her no matter what. Traveling with Cap's team the Invaders, Brunnhilde soon regained her memories and fought alongside them to free her friends from Brain Drain's control. During the course of the battle, both the Ring of the Nebulas and the Tekeli-Li were destroyed. Once freed from Brain Drain's mind control, the aliens realized that they could never return to the stars. Unwilling to remain abandoned on the planet Earth, they decided to take their own lives by diving into a pit of acid in Brain Drain's laboratory.

meat mother.name: Meat Mother
meat mother.origin: After Gorr travelled to far future, he began using the Pool of Forevers to abduct gods from across the timestream. After Gorr's death, several of these gods were left without homes and chose to settle in Asgard, while others sought out planets to preside over. When Thor the Avenger returned to the past, he brought back a group of gods to replace the original Sky Lords of Indigarr - who had been slaughtered by Gorr. Rose Father, became the leader of the gods, and together with The Choir, Our Lady of Comets, Meat Mother, and the Prince of Soot proceeded to terraform Indigarr from a desolate wasteland into a verdant garden, but as the eons passed they fell dormant and were assumed to have perished. Billions of years later, the Goddesses of Thunder awakened her and her brethern to help All-Father Thor fight against Loki, who had taken up the primordial symbiote All-Black. By the time they reached the battle, Loki had resurrected Gorr, who had reclaimed All-Black and was trying to drown Thor and Loki in its living abyss. The Sky Lords of Indigarr attacked Gorr, mockingly stating that they were his true legacy and helping the Goddesses of Thunder defeat him. However, Gorr revealed that his body had been a construct created by All-Black, taking over the primordial symbiote and using it to infect the very universe itself - attacking them with symbiote-infected planetoids.

mech.origin: Mech was a post-apocalyptic zealot living in a community in Mojave City, California were its members pretended to live in a dystopian world for fun. Some time after Hydra took over the United States, Mech stumbled upon Misty Knight on the road after her car had broken down. He offered to check out her car, and determined it wasn't an easy repair. After noticing Misty was trying to help hide a young Inhuman named Annie, Mech offered to help them seek refuge in his community, as it went ignored by most people. After making a stop to outfit Misty and Annie with the proper gear, Mech drove them to Mojave City and introduced them to his community, where Annie stayed. Misty would later go to assist other communities and bring more Inhumans to Mojave City. After numerous travels, Mech suggested she stayed for a little while longer.
