mechadoom.name: Mechadoom
mechadoom.origin: Mechadoom was initially intended to be a new line of Doombot created by Kristoff Vernard using research that Doom had deemed too dangerous. Kristoff stopped work before completion but the robot continued to build and improve itself until it gained enough sentience to leave Castle Doom. It gave itself the name Mechadoom and set up its own Doombot production line, in an attempt to improve the AI of them, but failed. Instead, he set about capturing robots with advanced AI's and was able to capture several including, Machine Man, Jocasta and others. Mechadoom attempted to capture Misty Knight but she escaped and enlisted the aid of Deathlok. The two found Mechadoom's base and on the first infiltration Misty's arm was blown off but discovered the others who had been captured. Deathlok tried again on his own but Deathlok was surprise ambushed by Mechadoom and rendered inert. While Mechadoom revelieved his origin, Deathlok rebooted and was assisted by Misty, Fantastic Four, X-Men, and Vision in taking down his Doombots. Mechadoom's power source was destroyed and so surrendered. He threatened to self destruct but was convinced to stop by Deathlok, before Reed Richards was able to improve his programming. With no ties to anyone, he decided to become a base for technical support for cyborgs, but was destroyed by Ultron who was angry at being captive and experimented on.
powers: same as the Doombots, to a much larger degree
weaknesses: He can't develop robots more advanced than his own body.

mechamage.name: Mechamage
mechamage.origin: The Fantastic Four were looking for magic users to help a friend named Alissa Maloy. Mechamage was able to listen in on a phone conversation. The Fantastic Four then went to free Margali Szardos, who had been captured by Selene. Mechamage teleported herself to the scene and helped free Margali. Transported to Limbo, they began preparing to battle Selene and her demonic ally Blackheart. Mechamage temporarily disguised herself as Alissa using an illusion spell. In the subsequent battle Mechamage attacked Blackheart and was able to prevent him from stealing the others' souls. Hellstorm and Margali pledged to help Mechamage and Alissa fight evil as the Shadow Hunters. Mechamage joined Margali, Agatha Harkness, the Scarlet Witch, Dakimh the Enchanter, Khalid Inshallah, and Jules St. Thomas in attempting to banish the Ego spore from Earth, but were unsuccessful.
powers: Mechamage can cast illusions, teleport, and fire blasts of magical energy. Her suit offers her protection and . It has an internal computer which can analyze potential magical threats.
abilities: Mechamage seems to be proficient in both magic and using technology.
weapons: Throwing blades which can disrupt other magic.

medgar dupaul.name: Medgar DuPaul
medgar dupaul.origin: Medgar DuPaul, born poor, was forced to work for a living from the age of four. He eventually amassed a fortune, but by then he was an adult, regretting the loss of his childhood. Determined to enjoy playing in his old age, DuPaul went to a Delaware town to organize a sadistic game in which he hunted human beings on his sprawling estate in a Delaware town (The town was named Backwoods, USA by Spider-Man, but this was probably a nickname). To do so, DuPaul used high technology such as a "hoverdisc", flying bulls with sensors, and remote-controlled automatic guns. DuPaul bribed the local sheriff, Andrews, paying him $500 for each person he brought to him, especially if they were strong, unrelated, and preferably unidentified. The corrupt Andrews provided DuPaul with vagrants and the like. None of the victims escaped, and they were buried in shallow graves. However, the constant disappearances of supposed escaped prisoners alerted Andrews' deputy Sarah, who became suspicious and investigated on her own. New York superhero Spider-Man confronted the villain Magma in Virginia and, after the fight, was left without any clothes, money, cards or identification. He hitchhiked to Delaware, but there he was arrested by Sarah, for stealing food, and taken to the county jail, where he claimed to be named Jay Jameson. In the cell, Spider-Man bent a metal bar to intimidate other prisoners, but Sheriff Andrews saw him and separated him from the other prisoners, who were going to the county work farm, to take him to DuPaul; Sarah secretly followed them. DuPaul explained the plan and gave her the advantage. Spider-Man was careful not to use his powers so as not to attract attention. Sarah tried to arrest DuPaul, but Andrews surprised Sarah and handcuffed her. Spider-Man, discovering the graves and the kind of person DuPaul was, decided to return to DuPaul's mansion to stop him, knocking out Andrews and rescuing Sarah in the process. Sarah grabbed a gun and apprehended DuPaul as he attempted to flee. Sarah allowed "Jay Jameson" to go for saving her life, but only after verifying that there were no federal warrants out for him.

medula.name: Medula
medula.origin: Medula was a Deviant woman who lived in Deviant Lemuria. Several decades ago, she met a scientist who called himself Maelstrom and mated with him. However, Maelstrom was an Inhuman/Deviant hybrid who depised his mother's race because they had killed her. Feeling shame for having consorted with a Deviant, he soon fled from Medula. However, their mating had left Medula pregnant with their child, a son who she named Ransak. Medula never told Ransak who his father was but, before she died, she did tell him that his father was a good man. Years later, Ransak was one of the five beings captured by Maelstrom's minions whose kinetic energy was drained from them and used to restore Maelstrom to existence in the physical world. Although Maelstrom's plan to destroy the universe was thwarted by some Eternals and the Fantastic Four, the energy he could drain from the five captives would have been enough to enable him to defeat his foes. However, upon sensing Inhuman energy mixed in with the Deviant and Eternal energies and tracing that energy to Ransak, Maelstrom realized that Ransak must be the only other person to share his forbidden mixed heritage -- his son! When Maelstrom revealed that he had once mated with a Deviant woman named Medula and Ransak confirmed that she had been his mother, Maelstrom was unwilling to kill his own son so he stopped siphoning energy from the captives and soon shrank out of sight. Although all five captives were restored to health, Ransak was devastated to realize that his mother had lied when she had told him that his father had been a good man. Feeling that he was just as much a lie as his mother's story, Ransak, for the first time in his life, began to cry.

fields.notes: Although Ransak's mother was first mentioned (and named) in , an earlier version of her was mentioned in Maelstrom's entry in . According to that entry, Maelstrom had once been married to a Deviant woman named Noma with whom he had dallied and had a son. However, when Maelstrom's father, the Inhuman geneticist Phaeder, had fallen out of favor with the ruling body of the Deviants, both his mate (Maelstrom's mother Morga) and Maelstom's mate had been put to death and Maelstrom's (unnamed) son had been sent to the slave pens. Given that the Head Writer of that first OHotMU series, Mark Gruenwald, was one of the writers who had created Maelstrom, it seems likely that the information presented in that Handbook entry was the backstory that Mr. Gruenwald had created for Maelstrom. However, since "Noma" was never even mentioned in any story while "Medula" was, that left Roy Thomas as the writer who created Maelstrom's mother. The entry on the Deviants in states that Maelstrom had "mated with the Deviant Medula, but abandoned her, unaware that she was pregnant with his son, Ransak." However, this is inconsistent with the story in in which Maelstrom, although never having met his son and not knowing his name, clearly knew of his existence. I presume this means that Maelstrom abandoned Medula after learning that she was pregnant and never bothered to learn anything about her child or even if the child had survived.

medusa gorgon.name: Medusa (Gorgon)
medusa gorgon.origin: ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== The Gorgon sisters did not worship their grandfather Set, but instead the Olympian gods, and all three of them served as chaste priestesses of Athena . Deities in their own right, the Gorgons were among the most beautiful in the world, and Medusa was the comeliest. Medusa lived on the remote isle in the shadow of Atlas, Atlantis. Eventually, Medusa laid with Poseidon on Athena's very altar. Enraged, Athena transformed the Gorgon sisters into scaly hags with snakes for hair. All their descendants bore the same curse, creating the snake-haired Gorgons. ===Perseus=== During the 14th century BC, Perseus located the Gorgons' hermitage in the wilderness surrounded by the petrified victims. Using his shield's reflective surface, Perseus beheaded Medusa and subsequently used her head as a weapon. The Shield of Perseus was then imbued with Medusa's power, turning those who look in its eyes to stone. It was wielded by Hercules as part of his post-invulnerability armament. ===Medusa-Land=== After Medusa's death, her daughter relocated to the subterranean world below Olympia: Medusa-Land. Medusa's daughter, who took her mother's name, became the ruler of the city. ===Hercules=== Generations later King Kreon of Pylos sent Hercules to retrieve the gold of Medusa from the Isle of Fear. On the island he encountered Medusa, alive and well, concealing her face behind a hood. Hercules and the Argonauts ended up slaying her once again. With Medusa's death, Jason and all her prior victims reverted back to flesh. ===20th Century=== Some time later Medusa moved to Paris, France with her husband, a blind Greek man. He won an art competition by using one of Medusa's victims as an art piece. Years later Mr. and Mrs. Grey bought the cursed European castle with Medusa imprisoned inside. Mr. Grey unknowingly released Medusa from her prison, but she failed to turn to stone. Thinking that her own curse had been somehow lifted, Medusa looked at herself in the mirror turning herself to stone. ===Modern Age=== ====Medusa's Head==== In modern times the head of Medusa was found in an archaeological dig in Greece by J. Collins Stacy. He held on to the head for many decades, until it was stolen from him by Mr. Collins. Mr. Collins hired Marc Spector to recover the head of Medusa. Spector managed to recover the head but in a petrified state. ====Wolverine/Hercules==== More recently the original Medusa was brought back to life via the Hand's resurrection ritual alongside with a number of Ancient Greek monsters to be used by Matsu'o Tsurayaba against Wolverine and Hercules. Medusa's attack was unsuccessful and resulted in beheading. Ironically enough, her head was used as a weapon against another resurrected Ancient Greek monstrosity, the Kraken. 300px|right|thumb|Medusa sees the body Wade Wilson (Earth-616)|Deadpool got her. ====Dracula's Gauntlet==== Sometime thereafter Medusa returned, only to be beheaded by Dracula once again. He then used her visage to turn Shiklah to stone. Upon defeating Dracula after a fierce battle, Deadpool struck a deal with Medusa to reverse the petrification of his wife in exchange for helping her get a new body, which turned out to have previously belonged to Frankenstein's Monster.
powers: Can turn people into stone with a simple gaze. Also able to reverse the effect of petrification.
weapons: Wielded dual Greek broadswords at least on one occasion.

family: Set (paternal grandfather/maternal great uncle) Gaea (maternal grandmother/paternal great aunt)
Echnida, Scylla, Sirens (Venus), Thoosa, and Gorgon sisters (Euryale, Stheno) (sisters)
Damballa, Dragon of the Moon, Sligguth, Yamata-no-Orochi (paternal uncles) Ishiti, Tartessus (paternal aunts) Chthon, Hyppus (great-uncles) Isuus, Oshtur (great-aunts)
fields.unusual_features: Scaly skin, has snakes for hair
fields.occupation: Hermit Formerly: priestess of Athena photographer

fields.history: ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== The Gorgon sisters did not worship their grandfather Set, but instead the Olympian gods, and all three of them served as chaste priestesses of Athena . Deities in their own right, the Gorgons were among the most beautiful in the world, and Medusa was the comeliest. Medusa lived on the remote isle in the shadow of Atlas, Atlantis. Eventually, Medusa laid with Poseidon on Athena's very altar. Enraged, Athena transformed the Gorgon sisters into scaly hags with snakes for hair. All their descendants bore the same curse, creating the snake-haired Gorgons. ===Perseus=== During the 14th century BC, Perseus located the Gorgons' hermitage in the wilderness surrounded by the petrified victims. Using his shield's reflective surface, Perseus beheaded Medusa and subsequently used her head as a weapon. The Shield of Perseus was then imbued with Medusa's power, turning those who look in its eyes to stone. It was wielded by Hercules as part of his post-invulnerability armament. ===Medusa-Land=== After Medusa's death, her daughter relocated to the subterranean world below Olympia: Medusa-Land. Medusa's daughter, who took her mother's name, became the ruler of the city. ===Hercules=== Generations later King Kreon of Pylos sent Hercules to retrieve the gold of Medusa from the Isle of Fear. On the island he encountered Medusa, alive and well, concealing her face behind a hood. Hercules and the Argonauts ended up slaying her once again. With Medusa's death, Jason and all her prior victims reverted back to flesh. ===20th Century=== Some time later Medusa moved to Paris, France with her husband, a blind Greek man. He won an art competition by using one of Medusa's victims as an art piece. Years later Mr. and Mrs. Grey bought the cursed European castle with Medusa imprisoned inside. Mr. Grey unknowingly released Medusa from her prison, but she failed to turn to stone. Thinking that her own curse had been somehow lifted, Medusa looked at herself in the mirror turning herself to stone. ===Modern Age=== ====Medusa's Head==== In modern times the head of Medusa was found in an archaeological dig in Greece by J. Collins Stacy. He held on to the head for many decades, until it was stolen from him by Mr. Collins. Mr. Collins hired Marc Spector to recover the head of Medusa. Spector managed to recover the head but in a petrified state. ====Wolverine/Hercules==== More recently the original Medusa was brought back to life via the Hand's resurrection ritual alongside with a number of Ancient Greek monsters to be used by Matsu'o Tsurayaba against Wolverine and Hercules. Medusa's attack was unsuccessful and resulted in beheading. Ironically enough, her head was used as a weapon against another resurrected Ancient Greek monstrosity, the Kraken. 300px|right|thumb|Medusa sees the body Wade Wilson (Earth-616)|Deadpool got her. ====Dracula's Gauntlet==== Sometime thereafter Medusa returned, only to be beheaded by Dracula once again. He then used her visage to turn Shiklah to stone. Upon defeating Dracula after a fierce battle, Deadpool struck a deal with Medusa to reverse the petrification of his wife in exchange for helping her get a new body, which turned out to have previously belonged to Frankenstein's Monster.

mega tony.name: Mega Tony
mega tony.origin: Mega Tony is a scientist and former agent of M.O.D.O.K., the mercenary organization of the eponymous professional. Tony was one of M.O.D.O.K.'s elite operatives, together with the sorceress Terrible Eye, thief Batroc the Leaper, and the organization's newest recruit, Gwenpool. Shortly after Gwen overthrew their boss and became leader of M.O.D.O.K., Mega Tony and the other elite members were kidnapped by an army of Teuthidans. The aliens had invaded Earth looking for Gwen, who had allegedly killed a platoon of their soldiers, a mission she had actually taken the credit for. M.O.D.O.K's benefactor, Vincent Doonan, even assisted the aliens in kidnapping Gwen's allies for leverage. He felt Gwen's plan to deal with the invasion was too irresponsible and chaotic, and believed forcing Gwen to surrender to the aliens was a much more peaceful option. Gwen managed to defeat the Teuthidans and rescue her friends at the cost of M.O.D.O.K.'s mobile base. With the base and its equipment lost, as well as any ties with their backer surely cut, Mega Tony, Terrible Eye, and Batroc decided to dissolve M.O.D.O.K. and part ways, much to Gwen's dismay. Following an encounter with Arcade, Gwen advised Mega Tony to apply for a job at Parker Industries. After showing some of his inventions to the company's CEO, Peter Parker, Tony was hired on the spot. Mega Tony later reunited with the rest of the former M.O.D.O.K. agents in anticipation for M.O.D.O.K. Superior's return to Earth. He swore revenge upon them only for their collective might to scare him off.
abilities: Chemist: Mega Tony is an expert in chemistry, being able to create different compounds for a variety of effects in relatively short order.

megan daemon.name: Megan Daemon
megan daemon.origin: Megan Daemon was born to a Scottish clan with hereditary access to magic and "dark power". She was born in 1904. While her older sister Alisabeth was born on the Winter Solstice, Megan was born on the Summer Solstice. Alisabeth attempted her first occult ceremony during her first menstrual cycle, using Megan as an unwitting assistant. Megan did not know the purpose of the ritual, but their mother's mutilated corpse was discovered the following day. A few years, later Megam had her own fiest menstrual cycle. Alisabeth convinced her to take part in another occult ceremony, and this apparently caused the death of their father. Alisabeth soon abandoned her sister to travel across Continental Europe. In 1922, Megan had her 18th birthday. Alisabeth send her a tarot card deck as a gift. In 1925, Megan had her 21st birthday and became legally an adult. Alisabeth briefly returned, but she quarreled with their clan's elders and may have caused their disappearance. While Alisabeth was the clan's heiress, she voluntarily abdicated her rights in favor of Megan. Before leaving, Alisabeth delivered to Megan a crystal pendant in the form of a cat's skull, which would supposedly help Megan to improve her knowledge of the Dark Arts. By the 1930s, Megan was considered an eligible bachelorette. She met and rejected many suitors, who were primarily interested in her wealth. But she befriended Ian MacGinnis, a member of the Royal Scots Borderers. The two had a joined vacation in 1937. When they visited Stonehenge as part of the jouney, they encountered Alisabeth in the process of opening a gateway for the Outer Dark. Megan apparently tried and failed to stop her sister, but her memories of the incident were erased. She regained consciousness two weeks later, having traveled to the United States aboard the LZ 129 Hindenburg. Alisabeth tried to summon an emissary from the Outer Dark towards the Hindeburg, but she was shot and incapacitated by Ian. Megan then fought the Emissary, though their battle set the Hindeburg on fire. Megan and Ian escaped the fire, but Megan was not certain whether Alisabeth also survived.
weaknesses: Megan has nearly identical powers with her older sister Alisabeth, but she has not been able to defeat Alisabeth in either of two attempts at a magical duel. She has also served as a pawn in Alisabeth's schemes for much of her life.

megan frost.name: Megan Frost
megan frost.origin: Megan was the firstborn daughter of Scott and Emma Summers. She was the oldest of their four children, which included two twin sisters and younger brother Alex (named after their deceased uncle Havok). Her older half-siblings Rachel and Nathan were both deceased. As a child of two leaders of the X-Men, Megan began training in the use of her abilities from a very young age. She learned what it means to be a mutant in a world of hate and fear and grew very comfortable around both humans and mutants alike thanks to her upbringing at the Xavier Institute. As a teen, she witnessed her friends and family brutally attacked by a combination of Skrulls and many of the X-Men's former foes. She was part of a group of Xavier Institute children who were captured by Mister Sinister, and grew closer to Olivier Raven during their imprisonment. They were eventually rescued and returned to their relatively normal lives. As she grew older, she fell in love with Oli. After helping them for awhile, she joined his young team of mutants, GeNext.

megan kinney.name: Megan Kinney
megan kinney.origin: Megan was the daughter of Deborah Kinney and the niece of Sarah Kinney. When Megan was young, she liked to send drawings to her Aunt Sarah, although she had never met her. Debbie also enclosed photos of Megan for Sarah to see. Megan was abducted by a serial child molester, and Sarah got X-23, the adolescent clone of Logan and assassin-in-training, to help track her down, sneaking her out of the Facility to do so. X-23 tracked the kidnapper by scent and disguised herself as a Girl Scout selling cookies. She let the kidnapper invite her into his apartment before killing him and throwing him from the window. After X-23 got Megan out of the building, Sarah sedated her and told her it was all a bad dream, before taking her back to her mother and claiming that she had found her wandering the streets. This had an unfortunate effect later in her life, as no one believed that Megan had really been kidnapped, including her therapist, who she was seeing for extreme post-traumatic stress. Megan began acting out during her teen years and seemingly had an obsession with her abduction, constantly drawing her attacker, as well as her savior. After Sarah's death, using the name Sarah had given her, Laura, formerly X-23, arrived at Debbie's house and stayed there with Debbie, Megan, and Debbie's boyfriend, Desmond. Laura told Megan that the incident when she was a child had been real, and she had been the one to apprehend her kidnapper. Megan demanded that she tell Debbie the same, although Laura refused, as she said it could alert the Facility to her location, and she explained her situation. Debbie arranged for Laura to go to school with Megan, although she had trouble fitting in and both she and Megan got suspended on her first day there. Rather than go home, the two stole the principal's car and had some fun, touring around several shops, watching a movie, and getting tickets to a concert. Unfortunately, Desmond was actually a Facility agent who attempted to use trigger scent to make Laura kill her aunt and cousin; however, he accidentally spilled it on himself, and was killed by X-23 soon after. Megan managed to rinse the trigger scent off of herself and Debbie, thus sparing their lives. Afterwards, Kimura and multiple Facility agents appeared in Debbie's house, and tried to kill them. Laura battled with Kimura, and after she won, she helped Debbie and Megan escape with new identities. Megan's new name was Elizabeth Victoria. ===Enemy of the State II=== Although it took her a great deal of effort, Kimura eventually managed to track Megan and her mother down. Though she considered killing them immediately, she instead chose not to reveal herself, and used them as leverage to force Laura into working for her during her gang war with Tyger Tiger. Megan and her mother were able to come out from hiding once again following Kimura's death at Laura's hands, allowing them to reunite with Laura as family, as well as meet Gabby, Laura's genetic clone and sister. ===Orphans of X=== After Laura found "Sarah" apparently alive in the Facility, she took her to Debbie and Megan's house, and Gabby met her there with Jonathan the Unstoppable. "Sarah" apologized to Laura, Debbie, and Megan for having lost so much time with them, and Megan became teary. Once Laura left the house to investigate gunfire, Gabby told Debbie and Megan to get down. Instead, Debbie picked up a frying pan and Megan picked up a knife, saying that they were willing to defend their home. When Daken entered with Laura, Megan was happy enough to welcome him despite his agitated demeanor; however, when Daken shot "Sarah" seemingly in cold blood, Megan attacked him with a frying pan, following Laura's lead. "Sarah" had actually been a clone made by the Orphans of X in order to extract information about the Muramasa Blade from Laura. Realizing this, all of them fled from the house and as they waited to catch a ride from Danger to Madripoor, Megan asked Laura about the Muramasa Blade. Megan said Laura shouldn't pay too much attention to the preachings of the Orphans of X, and that she had done a lot of good in the world; however, they were attacked by the Orphans of X and decided to change course to Tokyo, where they could get to Muramasa. Megan helped to bandage up Daken while he healed, and he apologized for his somewhat poor first impression. After Muramasa extracted parts of Laura, Gabby, and Daken's souls in order to make the Muramasa Armor, Megan helped look after them. Days later, when a rogue faction of the Hand came to take them, Megan and Debbie hid with Jonathan until Daken found them, carrying an injured Gabby. While Laura fought the Orphans using the Muramasa Armor, Daken asked Megan if he could borrow her phone. He warned her that was he was about to do was very disturbing, before slicing open his skin and embedding it underneath, so that he could get himself captured and allow Wolverine and Honey Badger to track him using Debbie's phone. Instead, Debbie picked up a frying pan and Megan picked up a knife, saying that they were willing to defend their home. When Daken entered with Laura, Megan was happy enough to welcome him despite his agitated demeanor; however, when Daken shot "Sarah" seemingly in cold blood, Megan attacked him with a frying pan, following Laura's lead. "Sarah" had actually been a clone made by the Orphans of X in order to extract information about the Muramasa Blade from Laura. Realizing this, all of them fled from the house and as they waited to catch a ride from Danger to Madripoor, Megan asked Laura about the Muramasa Blade. Megan said Laura shouldn't pay too much attention to the preachings of the Orphans of X, and that she had done a lot of good in the world; however, they were attacked by the Orphans of X and decided to change course to Tokyo, where they could get to Muramasa. Megan helped to bandage up Daken while he healed, and he apologized for his somewhat poor first impression. After Muramasa extracted parts of Laura, Gabby, and Daken's souls in order to make the Muramasa Armor, Megan helped look after them. megan loeb.name: Megan Loeb
megan loeb.origin: When she was a caterer, Megan Loeb met an officer named Robyn at a police party. They eventually married and lived together. One night when Megan was having a nightmare, Nightmare used her as a conduit to the real world. While Nightmare spared Megan's life, he altered the past so that she and Robyn never met. The following day, Megan rushed to her parents' house hoping to find Robyn there. Disheartened, Megan took her father's rifle and then appeared at the scene of a confrontation between Nightmare and Loki, interrupting the fight by shooting Nightmare through his torso. Nightmare prepared to retaliate against Megan, but Loki stopped him, proposing a duel after which Nightmare was killed. Afterward, Loki comforted Megan, encouraging her to go find Robyn to meet her for the first time again, assuring her that if they were soulmates, it would work out.

mei min.name: Mei Min
mei min.origin: === New Iron Fist === When Lin Lie washed ashore to K'un-Lun, half-dead and kept barely alive by the chi of the recently hatched Shou-Lao the Undying, he was found and rescued by Mei Min, who took him home to her family and nursed him back to health. Lin Lie stayed with Min and her family for the next few months during his training as the new Iron Fist and used her home to safeguard the remains of the Sword of Fu Xi, which he planned to reforge to keep Chiyou from being released back into the world. While Lin Lie was away to retrieve a piece of the Sword in Flushing, several of Chiyou's demon minions attempted to invade K'un-Lun for the Sword's remains, but were defeated by Min. When Lin Lie returned, Min recounted the events to him and took him home. Over dinner, Min vowed to help him with his quest to defeat Chiyou and to find a way to balance his chi and safely remove the shards of the sword embedded in his hands. thumb|left|With Iron Fist Min occasionally joined Lie on his journeys, helping him recover the Sword's pieces while fighting Chiyou's forces across the world. After returning from an excursion in Shanghai, Min and Lie were confronted by Yang Yi and his friends, who accused Lie of being unworthy of being the Iron Fist. Lie and Yi fought but were stopped and reprimanded by Sparrow Yu-Ti, to which Lie apologized for over Min's objections. Lie later confessed to Min that Yi was right about him being unworthy to wield the Iron Fist, but Min cheered him up by telling him the story of Wu Ao-Shi, an Iron Fist similar to Lie. Sparrow agreed with Min also offered some encouragement to Lie and took him under her wing to help him overcome his handicap, with Min assisting in his training. Min rushed to Lie's aid when the shards in Lie's flesh began radiating energy and left him in unbearable pain, signaling the destruction of Chiyou's first seal. The shards' energy led Lie and Min back to the Mei family residence, where they encountered a demon minion of Chiyou, who had previously killed and disguised himself as Min's father and gravely wounded Min's mother. When the demon demanded the Sword of Fu's other remains sealed in the Mei household, Min and Lie attacked him, with Yi joining to protect the two. The demon was too powerful for three of them and subdued Min and Yi, threatening to kill them if Lie didn't hand him the shards. Lie stabbed his arms with the remaining shards, preventing the demon from stealing them and empowering him enough to save Min and Yi and mortally wound the demon. With his dying breaths, the demon told him that Lie's brother Lin Feng destroyed the seal in the first tomb for Chiyou, and that he would be waiting for him at the second tomb. After tending to her mother's wounds, Mei, Lie and Yi immediately took a portal from K'un-Lun to Gansu. Shortly after arriving, the three encountered Fat Cobra and the Bride of Nine Spiders. Alongside Lie, Min and Yi courageously fought against the Immortal Weapons. Then, after the three noticed an explosion, she helped Lie gain altitude through the bamboo forest to reach Ji Shuangshuang's family mansion while she and Yi held off Fat Cobra and the Bride. She also self-proclaimed herself as the future Thunderer of K'un-Lun. Later, it was revealed the second sealed tomb was attacked by Chiyou's demon minions led by Lin Feng. Unexpectedly before she and Yi could arrive, Lie was knocked unconscious by the enemies. Knowing the priority, the Immortal Weapons and the two from K'un-Lun ceased combat to follow after Lie. They reunited with the former Iron Fist and Luke Cage then worked together to save Shuangshuang and the survivors while fighting off the murderous demon horde. Min and the others witnessed Lie fighting Feng followed by Lie's sword chi enlightenment. Lie successfully stabbed Feng in the left shoulder, but the sudden Warriors of K'un-Lun led by Sparrow Yun-Ti, previously called on by Luke, arrival through their portal on the mansion's grounds changed the tide of battle. Contrary, through K'un-Lun's closing portal, the sole Feng calmly entered the door at the cost of a few thousand demons to find the third, final tomb and free Chiyou. Unaware of K'un-Lun's upcoming fatal incident, she asked Yun-Ti if they could return to K'un-Lun. After Yun-Ti's vague reply, Min was excited by Danny's generosity to provide Rand Corporation supported modern era housing to the Warriors of K'un-Lun. Ecstatically, she and Lie also had the chance to learn martial arts from Danny. === Deadly Hands of K'un-Lun === She, along with Yang Yi, were presumably a part of Sparrow's resistance army that attempted to retake K'un-Lun but failed. She and Yi were involuntarily turned into War Fists by Feng, and ordered to invade New York City with the Steel Serpent. Min and Yi fought against Lie, who was hesitant to fight his old friends. Min and the other War Fists were freed from Chiyou's influence after Tiger's Faithful Daughter's necklace was destroyed. When Chiyou was resurre

meifeng.name: Meifeng
meifeng.species: Experimented on by the Weapon X Program
meifeng.first_appearance: Death of Wolverine: The Weapon X Program Vol 1 1
meifeng.origin: Meifeng was one of the individuals experimented on by Weapon X Program Director Abraham Cornelius in order to make a better soldier than his previous creations like Wolverine. After being released from her stasis tube, she was found by Sharp and the other test subjects. Scared but determined to get out of there, she joined up with the others. thumb|left|Meifeng and Sharp Sharp asked her to get a head count of how many soldiers were in the other room since they wouldn't see her due to her new abilities of super-speed. Meifeng used her speed to do exactly that which allowed the group to strategically make their way to the roof. The group was confronted by the villain Slayback, but Sharp killed him during the fight. Meifeng escaped the compound on a helicopter with the others. thumb|left|200px|Meifeng bulks up. Later on, Meifeng would soon break ranks with to group to check on her fiancee, only to be confronted by three opposing Weapon X soldiers. After briefly overpowering her, one of the soldiers told her the truth about how Dr. Cornelius looked up files to find a match for his next experiment,and while Meifeng and Taylor were trying to have a child, Cornelius described Meifeng as the perfect match. After the soldiers came to Meifeng and Taylor's house, they kidnapped Meifeng and killed Taylor. After the kidnapping, Cornelius then experimented on Meifeng, unexpectedly turning her from a man to a woman. Shocked and angry, Meifeng once again attempted to escape her captors who had tried to take her by force. Doing this managed to trigger her second mutant power, which enabled her to transform into a massive, hulking being. She then managed to turn the tables on her captors with the help of Skel and Junk.

meiko yin.name: Meiko Yin
meiko yin.origin: Meiko Yin, the cousin of one of Peter Parker's fellow photographers at the Daily Bugle, became engaged to a man named Karsano. Shortly after their engagement, they began to study the martial arts. However, Karsano, seeking new challenges, joined an offshoot of the Hand known as the True Believers. He became their assassin, known as the Dragonfly. Their sensei, Madam Qwa, ordered Karsano to kill Meiko to prove his loyalty. He accepted the challenge. He had three attempts to do so. Meiko came to New York City to meet Angela, to stay with her. She met her at a fair, but Karsano and a small group of True Believers attacked her. Spider-Man was present, however, and helped fight them. They drove of the ninjas, who fled. They later attacked Meiko on the roof of Angela’s apartment, again with Spider-Man in attendance. Spider-Man and Meiko humiliated Karsano, who committed a ritual suicide. Later, Madam Qwa told Meiko she had passed the test. The Dragonfly trained with some True Believers. Shortly afterwards, she was commanded to kill Spider-Man's friend and colleague, Joe "Robbie" Robertson. The Dragonfly and a group of True Believers attacked Robertson, only for Electro, who’d been hired by the Rose to kill the True Believers, to attack them. He would have killed her, if it were not for the intervention of Spider-Man and Robertson. As he saved her life, she spared him. The Hand, who had come to New York to stop the True Believers, were attacked by Elektra, who learned of the cult from them. She planned to stop them herself, so the Hand would depart. Meanwhile, outraged by Meiko’s failure, Madam Qwa offered a lenient punishment: to kill Angela Yin or be killed. She reluctantly accepted, but, when she received the opportunity, she fled. This was observed by one of the True Believers other assassins, Yano. He pursued her to a train yard, but was opposed by Spider-Man and Elektra. The heroes won, and the True Believers present were apprehended, alongside Yano. Meiko, meanwhile, quit the cult.

He became their assassin, known as the Dragonfly. Their sensei, Madam Qwa, ordered Karsano to kill Meiko to prove his loyalty. He accepted the challenge. He had three attempts to do so. Meiko came to New York City to meet Angela, to stay with her. She met her at a fair, but Karsano and a small group of True Believers attacked her. Spider-Man was present, however, and helped fight them. They drove of the ninjas, who fled. They later attacked Meiko on the roof of Angela’s apartment, again with Spider-Man in attendance. Spider-Man and Meiko humiliated Karsano, who committed a ritual suicide. Later, Madam Qwa told Meiko she had passed the test. The Dragonfly trained with some True Believers. Shortly afterwards, she was commanded to kill Spider-Man's friend and colleague, Joe "Robbie" Robertson. The Dragonfly and a group of True Believers attacked Robertson, only for Electro, who’d been hired by the Rose to kill the True Believers, to attack them. He would have killed her, if it were not for the intervention of Spider-Man and Robertson. As he saved her life, she spared him. The Hand, who had come to New York to stop the True Believers, were attacked by Elektra, who learned of the cult from them. She planned to stop them herself, so the Hand would depart. Meanwhile, outraged by Meiko’s failure, Madam Qwa offered a lenient punishment: to kill Angela Yin or be killed. She reluctantly accepted, but, when she received the opportunity, she fled. This was observed by one of the True Believers other assassins, Yano. He pursued her to a train yard, but was opposed by Spider-Man and Elektra. The heroes won, and the True Believers present were apprehended, alongside Yano. Meiko, meanwhile, quit the cult.

Meyer went to Krei Industries to confront him about what he had done and wanted to retrieve the blueprints for the technology, Krei ordered the robots to remove him. Using the technology she had created, Mel put a bandana over her face and took on the appearance of Krei. He left the restaurant with Cass and went to Krei's office where the real Krei was with the Big Hero 6. Alistair Krei activated the drones to take out Mel who freaked out and accidentally the drones activated becoming hostile towards everyone. Mel escaped being chased by the drones and got into Krei's limousine with Cass driving. The drones that were chasing Mel and Cass were destroyed by the Big Hero 6, in the forest Mel was arrested by the police and they took him away happy because Cass allowed him to write to her from jail.

melanie daniels.name: Melanie Daniels
melanie daniels.origin: Melanie Daniels was an actress who was constantly competing with Mary Jane Watson for the same parts. Mary Jane eventually won a recurring role in Secret Hospital, but due to other events in her life, ultimately quit, allowing Melanie to take her place which in turn led her to achieving bigger parts. Some time after this, Melanie invited Mary Jane to a play based on the Fantastic Four. Mary Jane brought along her friend Carlie Cooper, a big fan of Melanie's movies, since her boyfriend Peter was too busy to attend. Melanie invited both of them backstage, where she revealed that she was in fact playing the part of Invisible Woman. During the performance, the villain Electro came in and took Melanie hostage, leaving it up to people on the Internet to decide whether or not she should kill Melanie. Mary Jane suited up in one of Melanie's spare costumes and had Carlie distract Electro so that she could switch places with Melanie. Afterwards, Mary Jane continued distracting Electro, giving the stage manager Terry Ford enough time to unload a water tank on the villain, neutralizing her powers. After Electro was apprehended, Melanie complained to the reporters outside that all the attention was focused on Mary Jane despite her being the victim of the incident.

melanie killgrave.name: Melanie Killgrave
melanie killgrave.origin: Melanie and a friend were on a trip to Buffalo, where she met a strange man with purple skin. Introducing himself, the Purple Man fell in love with Melanie and used his ability to control the thoughts and actions of others to make her love him. They spent many months together until Killgrave released his hold on her. Revolted by what he had done, she fled, only to discover she was pregnant with his child. Melanie was extremely pleased when her infant daughter, Kara, was born with a normal complexion. However, when Kara was a teenager, her skin finally changed pigmentation and she soon discovered she had the same powers as her father. Meeting Alpha Flight, she eventually joined them as a member of a new Beta Flight. In the midst of an Alpha Flight hiatus, Kara returned home to live with Melanie along with her teammates, Laura & Goblyn Dean. Melanie was later delighted to hear that her husband had been killed by Namor, after Doctor Doom had used him in a plot for world domination. Melanie had lived with the constant fear that Zebediah Killgrave would come back into their lives. Unbeknownst to Melanie, the trio of girls fought off a figment of her husband sent by the Dreamqueen during their stay.

mele.name: Mele
mele.origin: ===Early Life=== Mele lived in an arboreal village of Botor with his young daughter, Leila. He became a widower under unrevealed circumstances, but was spared from committing suicide by Botor custom, as parental love took precedence over spousal love. ===Shanna the She-Devil=== One day he came to the rescue of a woman named Shanna the She-Devil while she was being attacked by a giant water snake. Although the two cannot communicate fluently in the same language, Mele expresses his feelings for Shanna and proposes to her through a Botor tradition of "Daliva," which translates to "love". Shanna, however, was torn between her growing attraction to Mele and her unresolved feelings for her on-off boyfriend Ka-Zar.As Shanna observed a funeral ceremony in the village, Mele helped her understand the meaning of Daliva and that it involved the belief in dying for the one you love. Mele then went on a hunting expedition with the other Botor men, but tragedy struck when one of them was killed. The next day, Mele again rescued Shanna from another snake attack, and she finally realized that he is in love with her. However, their moment was interrupted by Leila's screams as she was carried away by a sky-serpent. Mele tried to rescue his daughter but was unable to, and he prepares to commit suicide since Leila was his last surviving loved one. In an attempt to save Mele, Shanna hastily proposed to him, and he accepted. The two are married through the Daliva tradition and are seated together, trying to process their recent events, when they were interrupted by Ka-Zar's arrival carrying the rescued Leila. Mele and Ka-Zar found themselves in pursuit of a gruella, a dangerous and poisonous animal. In the heat of the moment, Mele threw a spear at the gruella, but it missed its target and struck Mele in the chest instead. The wound would likely have been fatal on its own, but the gruella's poison only hastened Mele's death. Ka-Zar, who was nearby, rushed to Mele's side and finds him dying at the foot of a cliff. In his final moments, Mele expressed his concern for his wife, Shanna, and his daughter, and asked Ka-Zar to take care of them both. Mele also confirmed his suspicion that Ka-Zar is in love with Shanna and dies content knowing that Ka-Zar will be there to protect them. However, the rest of the hunting party arrived on the scene just as Mele passed away and, upon seeing the spear that killed him and recognizing it as Ka-Zar's, they immediately accused Ka-Zar of murder.
weapons: Mele used primitive weapons such as knives, spears, and bows and arrows.

melf.name: Melf
melf.origin: The Elf with a Gun was an entity of unknown origin who used a variety of bizarre disguises to murder seemingly random people for no apparent reason at all over a period of several months. His path almost crossed that of the Defenders a few times, but they never actually met him or learned of his activities. He was first seen in a trailer park in California, where he knocked on the door of Tom and Linda Pritchett and presumably killed them both. He next appeared in Las Vegas, where he killed Charles and Frances Lester, then, disguised as a Native American shaman, he killed a couple named Sally and Stu, and finally, he killed an unnamed female protester of a film in a nearby public bathroom after she took shelter there to escape from the Hulk, who was rampaging outside the theater. The Elf (whose name was posthumously revealed to be Melf) was eventually run over by a truck before his motives could be established. Later, his nephew Relf apparently carried on his mission. A subsequent claim that the Elves with Guns were agents of the alien Tribunals and that Melf's murders were part of an elaborate scheme to restore the cosmic balance and stop a universal catastrophe was eventually revealed to be a hoax. As yet, the truth about the Elf with a Gun remains a mystery.

melinda brewer.name: Melinda Brewer
melinda brewer.origin: thumb|left|150pxDr. Melissa Brewer was a surgeon who worked in a deteriorating area of the South Bronx, where the constant exposure to violence and trauma led her into drug addiction. She began stealing narcotics from the hospital where she was employed and was eventually caught. To avoid arrest, she reached an agreement with the hospital administration, resigning her position and surrendering her medical license. While Punisher was incarcerated at Ryker's Island, he instructed Microchip to locate a plastic surgeon. After Castle’s escape, Microchip contacted Brewer. Following an encounter in which Castle eliminated men sent by the Kingpin to kill them, Brewer took Castle to an infirmary inside an abandoned chemical plant to perform the operation. After administering anesthesia, two drug-addicted criminals broke into the infirmary demanding narcotics. Brewer retrieved Castle’s assault rifle and killed them. Once the bodies were removed, she proceeded with the surgery. At Castle’s request, she altered his appearance so drastically that even his closest friend would not recognize him. Using her knowledge of tissue regeneration and melanin, Brewer changed Castle’s facial features and skin pigmentation, giving him the appearance of a Black man.

melinda mcdonough.name: Melinda McDonough
melinda mcdonough.origin: ===Childhood=== When Melinda was very young, her mother and father were afraid that there was something developmentally wrong with her brain; however, her uncle, Eddie McDonough, recognized that Melinda was actually a gifted intellect. A scientist and inventor himself, Eddie helped nurture and encourage Melinda's intellect, which led to her forging a close bond with him. thumb|left|Melinda tells her story ===Loss and Vengeance=== After Eddie was killed by Wolverine, while the latter was under the control of the Hand, Melinda was devastated. She vowed vengeance, and locked herself away in a secret bunker to devise a means of preventing Logan from hurting anyone ever again. Unfortunately, because she also virtually cut herself off from contact with the outside world, she never learned that Logan himself had perished, and that Laura Kinney moved into his apartment and took over the Wolverine name. Unable to bring herself to killing him herself, Melinda instead designed and built a gun capable of transporting a target into other dimensions. Still unaware that Logan was dead, Melinda located his apartment on Raddit, and set up her gun intending him to teleport him to another dimension where he would no longer be able to cause any damage. As a result, when she fired the weapon Laura was transported to Earth-65. However Melinda neglected to consider the implications of what might happen if someone was already occupying her target's destination, and by chance that universe's Gwen Stacy was performing with the Mary Janes in that same location in her home dimension. As a result, the weapon malfunctioned and caused Laura and Gwen to swap bodies. After returning home to Earth-616 with the help of Reed Richards, Laura as Spider-Woman enlisted Gwen's help as Wolverine, and together the two women tracked Melinda to her secret base in the Bronx. Melinda engaged them in a short fight, before she was unnerved after Gwen accidentally stabbed herself in the face while trying to use Laura's claws and rushed to get out of her armor before she threw up into her helmet. Confused at the presence of Gwen and Laura, she divulged her plot. With the situation cleared up, Melinda agreed to return Gwen and Laura to their own bodies, and sent the pair to their respective homes.
abilities: Melinda possesses a gifted intellect, and is a skilled inventor and engineer. She was capable of building her own version of the Hornet's Suit, a well-defended base complex she called her "nest," and even a trans-dimensional portal gun.
weapons: Trans-dimensional portal gun. Various booby-traps and automated defenses. The full extent of her armor's arsenal is unknown
however, it appears to have repulsors similar to that of the Iron Man Armor.
weaknesses: Melinda demonstrates a weak stomach, nearly vomiting into her own helmet when Gwen Stacy, trapped in Laura's body, accidentally extended Laura's claws into her own face.

melinda morrison.name: Melinda Morrison
melinda morrison.origin: ===Early Life=== Melinda Morrison lived her first year of life in the Midwest with her parents. When the Kennedys were alive and on the political scene, Melinda wanted to vote for them, but she was too young. Shortly after, Melinda went to New York and attended a conference about occultism held by Xandu. Melinda was charmed by the mystic; that same night the two became lovers. Melinda became Xandu's assistant. Unfortunately, during one of his experiments, the arcane energies released by Xandu unwittingly hit Melinda with a deadly bolt. Melinda fell and Xandu couldn't revive her. She apparently slept in a state similar to death, but Xandu didn't understand that she was actually dead and she only seemed sleeping. ===The Wand of Watoomb=== Xandu discovered that an object of incomparable power could help him to revive Melinda: The Wand of Watoomb. After many years Xandu managed to steal the Wand from Doctor Strange. His plan was thwarted by Strange and Spider-Man before he could use it on Melinda. After having Spider-Man steal the Crystal of Kadavus, and restoring the Wand, he was defeated by Doctor Strange and Spider-Man again. Strange offered to help, but Xandu's illusion was broken: Melinda was actually dead. Xandu's became insane due to his delusion. ===Death Dimension=== When Xandu used the Wand and transferred the Scarlet Witch's soul into Melinda's empty body, Melinda's soul arrived--as a glowing sphere--switched places with Wanda's soul and appeared before Xandu offering him to join her in the afterlife. Terrified, believing that she wanted revenge, he attacked her to no avail. After Spider-Man attacked Xandu, Melinda brought Scarlet Witch, Spider-Man and the Wand back to Earth. Soon Xandu, after destroying his on world, died and took Melinda's place in the Death Dimension. ===John Kowalski=== Melinda returned to California and fell in love with John Kowalski, an avatar of Death. The relationship with John didn't last when she found what he really was. After running from Kowalski Melinda sought the Scarlet Witch's help. Wanda channeled Death, who stated that it had no further use for Kowalski. Melinda begged Death to show mercy on Kowalski for she still loved him and Death agreed, giving him three more years to be with Melinda and train his successor. ===Return to the Death Dimension=== Soon Melinda started to have nightmares which were sent to her by Xandu who was in Death Dimension. She was about to commit suicide when Spider-Man intervened. Soon they were attacked by demons from the Death Dimension until Doctor Strange arrived. Soon Xandu possessed Spider-Man, stole the Wand of Watoomb, and kidnapped Melinda. After the two sorcerers arrived in the Realm of Death where Xandu sent Melinda and Spider-Man the already damaged dimensional walls started to break up causing dimensional earthquakes which threatened to destroy both the Realm of Death and Earth, all because of the contemporary presence of Melinda and Xandu. Strange warned Xandu but he couldn't accept to be separated from Melinda again. Xandu fought Strange and Spidey until Melinda screamed and her voice cured the Death Dimension and she became the queen of the realm. Strange, Spider-Man, and Xandu returned to Earth, but when Xandu returned to the Death Dimension, Melinda went into suspended animation. ===Merging of Dimensions=== Sometime later, Melinda awoke and when she found out that Xandu was trying to merge both dimensions she tried to convince Xandu to stop. But Xandu's powers and determination was so great he succeeded in merging the dimensions. On Earth the dead rose from their graves. Melinda tried again to stop him but Xandu entranced her. Since Doctor Strange and Scarlet Witch couldn't break through Xandu's defenses Strange transported Melinda to Earth, right into Captain America's arms. Xandu followed her, while the death-demons battled the heroes. A simple gesture from Melinda was enough to freeze the walking dead but Xandu countered her command. Because the merging wasn't complete, painful spasms hit Melinda and Xandu as the world couldn't handle them both. While Xandu enforced his spell, Captain America told Melinda to become the queen Xandu wanted. Melinda convinced Xandu to return to the Death Dimension but there she asked Doctor Strange for help. Strange merged the demon-lords' powers and added them to Melinda, making her supreme ruler of the Death Dimension. With all that power Melinda defeated Xandu and banished him from the Death Dimension to Earth. She also refused his love. She sent the heroes back home. On Earth Xandu cried and Melinda did too, knowing that they would never be together again, neither among the living or the dead.
powers: Scream (only for the Death Dimension)
weaknesses: Can't stay far from the Death Dimension or she'll become unstable, depressed and obsessed with death.

melinda pressman.name: Melinda Pressman
melinda pressman.origin: When Melinda was only a child, she saw her father Max murder her mother Maria, and then attempt to kill both her and her brother Michael. Max was shot dead by the police, and Michael and Melinda ended up in foster care. Years later, as an adult, Melinda was haunted by her father, who had become the malignant spirit Wallow, capable of feeding off of and amplifying people's negative emotions. Eager to finish off his children, Wallow used his powers to compel Melinda to jump off of a ten-story building. As luck would have it, Ghost Rider was passing nearby, and he found Melinda still barely alive and rushed her to the hospital. After trying to compel Michael to suicide, Wallow went to Melinda's bedside and tried to push her to kill herself. However, Melinda managed to overcome his influence thanks to her hatred of her father, and instead attacked him. Ghost Rider soon arrived and subjected Wallow to his Penance Stare, dissolving him and sending him to Hell. Melinda's activities since then are unrevealed.

melinda taylor.name: Melinda Taylor
melinda taylor.origin: Caitlin and Lauren Strucker schedule a meeting with Dr. Melinda Taylor, the psychiatrist who handled Rebecca while she was at Linwood. They pretend to be Rebecca's distant family members, but Dr. Taylor quickly sees through their guise. Lauren takes a more direct approach, and destroys Dr. Taylor's phone just as she was about to call security. Caitlin convinces her to help them, showing them footage of Rebecca brutally killing a member of the hospital's staff with her mutant powers. The doctor says she knew they couldn't be Rebecca's family because she killed them all in the same way.

melior.name: Melior
melior.origin: Pressyne, daughter of the serpent lower-bodied demoness Maralith and descendant of Set, took on the form of a fairy and married Elynus on the condition he would not see her in labor. Pressyne gave birth to triplet daughters, but Elynas rushed into the birthing chamber, causing Pressyne to depart with her daughters, Melusine, Melior, and Palatyne, and fled to the lost isle of Avalon . On their 15th birthday, Melusine learned the reason for their banishment, and consequently led her sisters to capture Elynas and imprison him in a mountain. Learning about it, an angered Pressyne punished her daughters for their disrespect. Melior's punishment and whereabouts afterwards remain unrevealed so far.

melissa collier.name: Melissa Collier
melissa collier.origin: Melissa Collier and her husband, James Collier were at the family home when his uncle was found dead. After meeting with the police, they contacted the family lawyer Jerome Ralston who revealed the specific burial request and that the family fortune would be divided equally but only after a year if they looked after his corpse as requested. However, Franklin Collier was discovered murdered and the ghost of his uncle was blamed. Several more family and servants turned up dead and James realized that an extra stipulation of the will had been removed which stated that Ralston would get all the money if the family could not collect it. He confronted Ralston but was knocked out by Jason Collier who was conspiring with Ralston. Unbeknownst to James, he was saved by the Zombie.

melissa hutchins.name: Melissa Hutchins
melissa hutchins.first_appearance: The Daily Bugle on Tumblr Vol 1 1
melissa hutchins.origin: Melissa Hutchins was a writer for the Daily Bugle. She regularly defended Spider-Man as a hero, as seen when she supported the use of graffiti depicting him and his logo, after her boss, J. Jonah Jameson, libeled him in a post on the Bugle's Tumblr page weeks prior. Around Christmastime of 2013, Melissa wrote a short post for the Bugle's Tumblr page about how the city of New York was in the giving mood and wanting to give Spider-Man free personalized drinks, free cab rides, and even free rent. Later that same month, Melissa wrote about a local shop owner in lower Manhattan who, in order to scare away potential robbers, had created a warning sign with Spider-Man on it. Throughout the entirety of January 2014, Hutchins wrote multiple short post on the Bugle's Tumblr page revolving around how the people of New York were truly embracing Spider-Man by offering him free food at restaurants , writing messages of support in the snow with some dubbing themselves as "Amazing Spider-Fans" who would come out during the Super Bowl of that year in a show of support for Spidey as opposed to the teams playing. Similarly, she continued reporting on the global love for Spider-Man that was occurring around the country at events such as Mardi Gras, spring break holiday , and SXSW in Austin, Texas ; the first, she stated, would have an elaborate Spider-Man float that would swing around New Orleans, and that Amazing Spider-Fans were out in droves sporting red and blue beads. She would continue to write about the ever-growing love of Spider-Man that was occurring at sporting events such as the NCAA Tournament , the start of baseball season where she speculated that Spidey might be a New York Mets fan , and on holidays such as St. Patty’s Day where they would paint his murals across the subway green. On April Fools Day 2014, Melissa reported that the SUV of J. Jonah Jameson had been covered in webs in a lighthearted retaliation for what Jameson had said about Spider-Man constantly refusing to speak to the press. It was unclear whether it was Spider-Man himself or one of his loyal Spider-Fans. Later that month, she wrote a short piece where she wrote about Spider-Man's daily heroic deeds beyond just fighting crime, including helping parents and kids cross busy intersections, celebrating local Centenarian birthdays, or filling in for crane operators.

melissa jenkins.name: Melissa Jenkins
melissa jenkins.origin: Melissa Jenkins was a young woman who was engaged to James Gordon. However, after being bitten abd turned into a vampire, she sought to turn her fiancée James into one so that they could be together. Although, she was rejected by her fiancée, who then had her locked away in a coffin rather than killing her. Many years later, Melissa awakened, only to find the world has changed significantly after being locked away for many years. Seeking revenge, she eventually finds that her home was now under the care of James's grandson Jim.
weaknesses: As a vampire, Melissa saw that the light of the sun was deadly to her.

melissa scott.name: Melissa Scott
melissa scott.origin: Tinsel was one of the enhanced individuals recruited by Dr. Rachel Deming to join the Exiles, a group formed to protect and assist victims of the Theta virus. After contracting the Theta virus herself, Tinsel was brought under Deming’s care. Deming helped her bring the condition into remission and trained her in controlling her newfound abilities. Tinsel then became an active field member of the Exiles, assigned to Alpha Team alongside Deadeye and Trax. The team’s first major mission involved locating and retrieving a new Theta virus victim, Amber Hunt. Despite interference from Malcolm Kort’s agent, the Supreme Soviet, they successfully extracted Hunt. During the battle, Trax was injured, and Tinsel transported him back to the Exiles’ base, the Stronghold. There, she learned that the Beta Team—comprising Mustang and Catapult—had been sent to locate another target, Timothy Halloran. When Beta Team’s mission failed, the full Exiles roster moved to Kort’s Visionary Productions compound. Just as they arrived, Halloran emerged, having mutated into the powerful being known as Mastodon. As he rampaged, Tinsel managed to evade one of his strikes and shield her teammate Ghoul, but the distraction left them vulnerable. Both were captured by Kort's operative, Hot Rox. Kort planned to use Tinsel as leverage, but allowed the violent agent Bloodbath to take custody of her. When Bloodbath attempted to assault her, Tinsel unleashed her powers in full, blinding him. Though disoriented, he managed to fire his weapons wildly, hitting her in the shoulder. Her cry of pain gave away her position, and Bloodbath gunned her down. Ghoul later discovered her body. Using his abilities to commune with the dead, he learned what had occurred and exacted revenge on Bloodbath.

melkori.name: Melkori
melkori.origin: Melkori (or Melikori) was a Thuranian shaman, living at Cloud Peak. He leagued himself with Ducalon, count of Komahar, who with fellow conspirators Baron Kaanuub, Enaros, and the poet Ridondo. Melkori created animated wax human-mimicking figures in the form of Red Slayers, as well a woman. He then presented himself at the court in the guise of Baron Lann of the Northmarches, with his "daughter" Jirane. The fake Red Slayers scoured the city, massacring at random and stirring hatred towards Kull, while "Jirane" seduced Kull and took him on a sailing trip. Kaanuub and Ducalon tried to quell down the slaughter but Melikori refused, reminding them that he alone controlled the waxen soldiers. Kull returned, defeated the waxen soldiers and thus revealed the truth, before throwing Melkori into the enraged crowd who presumably torn him apart. When Kull was drugged with a Zarfhaanan witch-brew that made him see demons, he successively accused Melikori, "Lann", or Thulsa Doom, to be the slain wizard that tried to attack him from beyond the grave.

melodi maclain.name: Melodi MacLain
melodi maclain.origin: Daughter to industrialist Marcus Wellington, Micky MacLain took her mother's last name at a young age. Learning her father was developing a computer virus that would enable him to take over the world, she stole the virus and fled with her boyfriend Braun Sehler, but the two were shot down over "Paradise Island", and taken hostage by the Irkutsk Liberation Front. Held for ransom, Wellington hired the mercenary industrialist Arno Stark to rescue her. Managing an escape on her own with Sehler, the duo nearly evaded the ILF, during which MacLain revealed her knowledge of the virus, resulting in Sehler's revelation that he was actually the ILF's leader. Taken back into captivity, MacLain was rescued shortly after by Stark, who she informed of the Virus, convincing him not to turn her back into her father. Following Stark's defeat of Wellington, MacLain took control of her father's company.

melodia dias.name: Melodia Dias
melodia dias.origin: Melodía Días was an operative of the International Court of Justice travelling incognito aboard the Pan-South America Jaguar Limited's inaugural trip in order to ensure one of its passsengers, Samovarian dictator General Felipe Salvadora, arrived safely to its destination so he could be arrested by Argentinian authorities. During the trip, she encountered S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Nick Fury, who had been tasked with a similar mission as hers. Knowing Fury was aboard the train, Melodía sat back to let him take care of any of Salvadora's would-be assassins. Once all murder attempts had been thwarted, Melodía and Nick officially introduced themselves to each other. The ensuing flirting was interrupted when Fury was notified of yet another assassin, which forced him to get back in action.

melody guthrie.name: Melody Guthrie
melody guthrie.origin: thumb|left|The depowered Melody visits the Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters|X-Mansion for Icarus' death One of ten siblings, Melody Guthrie was the fourth of the Guthrie children to have manifested mutant abilities. Sent to join her kin at the Xavier Institute, Melody ultimately lost her powers with the advent of M-Day. Believing she still had her powers, she jumped off a building, but was saved by Beast in the nick of time. Since then, she lived at home with her mother, Lucinda, and her other siblings. She briefly returned to the Institute after the death of her brother Josh to say goodbye. She eventually took a job as an administrator for Camp Gloriana, where Storm was a keynote speaker, leading to their reunion. Melody later went to live on the newly-created mutant-only nation of Krakoa. There, she became the first to undergo a novel ritual called the Crucible, a trial of combat against Apocalypse to earn the right to die and be resurrected by the Five, in order to regain her lost powers. In front of a large ensemble of mutants, she was brutalised by Apocalypse, who urged her to give up and ask to be healed instead of persisting in the fight. Melody refused and was ultimately killed by Apocalypse, passing the trial of Crucible. She later claimed her prize when she was resurrected by the Five, with her former powers returned to her. She decided to stay on Krakoa when it merged with the White Hot Room.

melody jacobs.name: Melody Jacobs
melody jacobs.origin: ===Origins=== Melody Jacobs was a mutant with the power to sense people dying and absorb their dying energy. However, she had little control over it, and all the deaths happening around the world, especially the agony of the mutants suffering from the Legacy Virus, started taking a toll on her and she began losing her mind. She started living on the streets of New York City and was found by the monstrous Abomination, who took her to a homeless haven underground. It was then that she was nicknamed Threnody, after her mournful cries. Upon accidentally killing a couple of fellow homeless people, she left the haven, and ended up on the streets of Los Angeles, where her uncontrolled powers kept causing destruction with bursts of death energy. 180px|thumb|left|Living on the streets Later, she sought shelter in the laboratory of Gordon Lefferts, the first recorded victim of the Legacy Virus, and, when the X-Men Beast, Rogue and Iceman came to the lab to search for clues on how to cure the virus, they found Threnody, who surprised them with her knowledge of the virus before fleeing. Curious, Rogue went after her, only to find her in the arms of Mister Sinister, who had also been investigating the virus. Sinister offered to help Threnody, seeing her potential as an aid in hunting down infected mutants, but Rogue intervened, not wanting Threnody to be a victim of Sinister's plans. However, when Hank arrived at the scene, he realized that Sinister was perhaps Threnody's best option, and her helping Sinister could actually be beneficial for the entirety of mutantkind, so they allowed Threnody to leave with him. Under Sinister's care, Threnody had huge improvements, gaining control of her powers thanks to small neuro-chips that Sinister placed around her face. In return, she was plugged to Sinister's systems to scan for mutants afflicted with the Legacy Virus, which also allowed her to learn more about the world in general, by tapping into his data banks and assimilating vast quantities of information. 180px|thumb|right|At her monitoring room When the X-Men invaded Sinister's lab, they found Threnody, and she secretly helped them sabotage Sinister's genetic data banks, but, despite Beast's offer, she refused to leave with them, as she believed she could do the most good from the inside. She kept using Sinister's banks to learn more about the world and, as he grew suspicious of her, she began plotting her escape. During her constant monitoring, she learned of the existence of Nate Grey, a refugee from an alternative timeline, whom she viewed as her ticket to freedom. Therefore, when Sinister asked about Nate Grey, she lied and told him she'd never even heard the name before. ===With Nate Grey=== Feeling her time running out, Threnody tried to escape and seek out Grey. Sinister immediately sent his Marauders after her, and they caught up with her in the sewers of Paris, where Threnody knew Grey was currently located. Just as Threnody was cornered by her pursuers, Grey heard her telepathic screams and jumped to her rescue. He mercilessly slaughtered all of the Marauders except Riptide, in whom he placed a false mental image of Threnody dying to deter Sinister from pursuing her further. Having nowhere to go, Threnody decided to tag along with Grey. 180px|thumb|left|Escaping with Nate Grey They found themselves in the Swiss Alps, where they found Grey's counterpart Cable and also the ancient mutant Exodus. A fierce battle erupted between the three, and Threnody's life essence was nearly drained by Exodus, but Grey intervened and defeated the villain, burning himself out in the process due to the over-extension of his powers. Cable helped save his life, but Grey was still left unconscious. The Red Cross rescued them and brought them to a ski-lodge. Grey woke up to find Threnody kissing him and began to question whether he had been a pawn of Sinister all along. He reached deep into her mind to find the truth, but only ended up understanding her struggle more. Hoping to help her, he tried to remove one of her neuro-chips, but this caused an explosion, which took all of Grey's strength to stop from killing everyone, once again leaving him unconscious. Threnody thought of leaving him alone after the transgression to her private space, but couldn't bring herself to do it and decided to take Grey to a Mediterranean beach to relax. While at the beach, they were attacked by one of Grey's old enemies, the nefarious Holocaust. Several bystanders were injured in the process, and Threnody, sensing the pain, rushed to their aid, finding a man mostly crushed under a boulder. He was very close to death, but still trying to hold on; however, his death energy was intoxicating to Threnody and she used her powers to end his life for good. This caught the attention of Holocaust, who captured the girl to use her as a bargaining chip against Grey. He tried to communicate with Threnody telepathically, but when she didn't respond, he was forced to e
weaknesses: Left alone, her powers are uncontrollable, to the point of possibly driving her insane. She wears neuro-chips Mr. Sinister gave her to stabilize her powers.

melody maxwell.name: Melody Maxwell
melody maxwell.origin: Melody Maxwell was a Mutant who in the 4th grade discovered her ability was to make plants grow but found herself unable to stop it. She contacted the X-Men and Storm and Wolverine visited her and helped her develop her abilities to both grow and shrink plants on command. Later that day, Melody took the pair to her school flower show but wass knocked into some venus fly traps and caused them to grow to an immense size and attack. The fly traps overwhelmed Wolverine and Storm, so melody attempted to shrink them but was unsuccessful. To defeat the fly traps, Melody instead grew another flower which trapped the fly traps. Returning home, Melody asked to join the X-Men but they tell her she needs more time to develop her abilities.

melody taylor.name: Melody Taylor
melody taylor.origin: Melody Ann Taylor was the wife of Daryl Taylor and mother to Dwayne Taylor aka Night Thrasher. Melody and Daryl were high school sweethearts and were married at 18. Melody and Daryl were murdered by Daryl's best friend Andrew Chord. Melody was presumably unaware that her husband had an affair and fathered an illegitimate son named Donyell Taylor. Ironically the thing that marked Daryl and Melody for death was Daryl's refusal to cheat on Melody and father a child with a member of the Dragon's Breadth Cult per Tai's instructions. She was mentioned to have died at some point in time by her son.

meltdown russian.name: Meltdown (Russian)
meltdown russian.origin: Meltdown, a former Soviet general, and his ally, Doc Neutron, planned to explode a nuclear power plant, intending to absorb the radiation. The accident occurred, resulting in many casualties, but Meltdown was unable to absorb the radiation released, so he and Dr. Neutron were locked up in an asylum. However, they managed to take control of the asylum and from there plotted, exploiting Havok's energy-absorbing abilities, to harness the radiation released by a nuclear accident, also caused by them, at a reactor in India. Their plan failed once again, thanks in part to the intervention of Wolverine, who had rushed to Havok's aid. Some time ago, Meltdown physically reconstituted himself in the Siberian Desert, also discovering that he was able to absorb the life energy of living beings. Traveling to America, Meltdown found the depowered Morlocks society known as the Dregs and established a society in the Salton Sea area of California, telling them that he would restore their powers with his radioactivity, but instead he sickened them with radiation poisoning, thus absorbing their life energy and simultaneously empowering himself. His reign was ended by the intervention of Elixir and Wolverine, with Wolverine killing him for the second time.
powers: Meltdown could absorb and project radioactive energy as blasts. He could also regenerate, and absorb life energy from others.

melter hobgoblin.origin: After Bruno Horgan was killed by Scourge, the gear he used as Melter was sold by the Hobgoblin to an unnamed criminal. This new Melter was present during a battle between Hobgoblin's forces and the Goblin Nation. He, along with every other Hobgoblin franchise, joined Team Goblin when the Goblin King apparently killed Hobgoblin, though it was really Kingsley's butler, Claude. During the second superhuman civil war, the Melter tunneled his way into a diamond exchange vault. After managing to obtain a handful of diamonds, he accidentally git a gaspipe, causing a sinkhole. Despite injurying bystanders, the Melter survived, and the silkhole he triggered covered his tracks. Spider-Woman investigted the incident and managed to find the Melter in the bar the Quiet Room with help of a vision of the precognitive Inhuman Ulysses Cain. When the boast of his success erupted laughs in the rest of the patrons, the Quiet Room's owner, Black Bolt, had him kicked out. Outside the bar, the Melter was knocked out by Spider-Woman's ally the Porcupine and left to the authorities. When Tony Stark moved to a brownstone in the Lower East Side, the Melter broke into his garage and melted his car to antagonize him. Returning home from a hard day, Iron Man stumlbed into the Melter standing next to his car, and silently knocked him out with one punch. Due to the ongoing stress of his life, Stark took flight carrying the villain's unconscious body and tossed him from a high altitude, only catching him moments before he hit the ground.

melusine.name: Melusine
melusine.origin: Pressyne, daughter of the serpent lower-bodied demoness Maralith and descendant of Set, took on the form of a fairy and married Elynus on the condition he would not see her in labor. Pressyne gave birth to triplet daughters, but Elynas rushed into the birthing chamber, causing Pressyne to depart with her daughters, Melusine, Melior, and Palatyne, and fled to the lost isle of Avalon. On their 15th birthday, Melusine learned the reason for their banishment, and consequently led her sisters to capture Elynas and imprison him in a mountain. Learning about it, an angered Pressyne punished her daughters for their disrespect, including Melusine being cursed to become a "serpent from the waist down" every saturday. Roaming the world, Melusine ended up in the forest of Colombiers in Poitou, France, where she met Raimond de Lusignan who had accidentally slain his uncle, the count. Melusine soothed Raimond's woes, concealed his guilt. She granted him great wealth, and bore him ten sons, including Geoffrey and Urian, all somewhat deformed. Eventually, Raimond followed Melusine and had a glimpse at her true form, losing her forever. As she vanished, Melusine swore that when she appeared over the castle Lusignan, it would get a new lord within the year. Melusine sired Yith, a daughter with the lower body of a serpent, in Poitou, though the identity of the father remains unrevealed.
