michael nowlan.name: Michael Nowlan
michael nowlan.origin: Michael Nowlan and his wife Susan were both heroin addicts before he was drafted into the Vietnam Conflict in his late teens. His mutant powers first surfaced during the war, but became fully apparent only after his detox in a military rehab center. When he met a fellow veteran—who would later become Timeshadow—Nowlan's ability triggered the manifestation of the man's temporal duplication power. Word of Nowlan's unique power to boost mutant abilities quickly spread, and other mutants began seeking him out, often by force. Addicted to the sensation, they repeatedly coerced him into enhancing their powers. To stop this, Nowlan remained under the influence of heroin, which dulled his mutant output—but doing so cost him his job, his health, and his marriage to Susan, who had cleaned up and moved on. Eventually, Nowlan was found by Apocalypse, who made him a pawn in his plans. Apocalypse constructed a device that could manage Nowlan's addiction and manipulate his powers. With this setup, Nowlan was used to amplify the strength of Apocalypse's minions, the Alliance of Evil. Nowlan eventually escaped and sought help from his ex-wife, Susan. She refused to be drawn back into his destructive life, but contacted X-Factor—who at the time were posing as mutant hunters to locate and protect mutants. Susan's attempt to leave town was interrupted when the Alliance captured her to force Nowlan's cooperation. X-Factor found Nowlan and stabilized him after a near-fatal overdose. They planned to support his recovery, but the Alliance returned, threatening Susan to make Nowlan boost their powers. He complied, allowing them to overpower X-Factor and bring both him and Susan back to Apocalypse's base. At the base, Nowlan was once more connected to the machine and used to augment the Alliance's powers again. When X-Factor returned to stop them, Stinger accidentally killed Susan during the chaos. Devastated, Nowlan absorbed all the enhanced energy back into himself, giving X-Factor the edge they needed to win. However, the energy overload proved too much for him, and he died believing the world would be better off without him. Michael was later resurrected by the Five on Krakoa, but refused to work for their government because unlike him Susan could not be resurrected because she was human.
powers: Nowlan radiated pulses of energy that supercharged superhuman abilities or drove them out of their owner's control. This energy was highly addictive.
weaknesses: Addicted to drugs, usually heroin

michael pressman.name: Michael Pressman
michael pressman.origin: When Michael Pressman was only a child, his father Max murdered his mother and tried to kill him and his sister Melinda. Fortunately for the two children, the police intervened and shot Max, killing him. Michael and Melinda were funneled through the foster care system, where they struggled to make sense of their father's crimes. In adulthood, Michael became an alcoholic living homeless on the streets. Eventually, Max returned as Wallow, a malignant spirit capable of feeding off negative emotions. Unwilling to accept that his children had survived, he first possessed Melinda, goading her into stepping off a ten-story building. Thanks to the chance intervention of Ghost Rider, Melinda was taken to the hospital, and so Wallow turned his attentions to Michael. He induced Michael to jump off a rooftop, but Michael regained his senses just in time to catch an open windowsill and pull himself inside. Seeking refuge at a church, Michael was saved by Ghost Rider, and explained that Wallow was his father. The two hurried to Melinda's hospital room, where Wallow made another attempt to drive her to kill herself, but Melinda's hatred for her father allowed her to overcome his influence and stab him. With the tide turned against him, Wallow was subjected to Ghost Rider's Penance Stare, which dissolved him, leaving Michael and Melinda to rebuild their relationship. Michael's activities since then are unrevealed.

michael proudhawk.name: Michael Proudhawk
michael proudhawk.first_appearance: Untold Tales of the New Universe: Psi-Force Vol 1 1
michael proudhawk.origin: The original Psi-Hawk appeared to be a gestalt entity created by the collective minds of the Psi-Force in times of need, which was based on their memories of the late former CIA agent Emmett Proudhawk; however, Psi-Force always suspected that this was not the full truth as the Psi-Hawk appeared to be able to act against their wishes and to exert an influence on their minds which prevented them from splitting up, and Emmett's brother Eugene also recognized the Psi-Hawk as being somehow his brother. Emmett's cousin Michael Proudhawk, also a CIA agent and who shared Emmett's gift for telepathically influencing the minds of others, was also able to generate a Psi-Hawk, identical to the original but in a red and brown rather than a red and blue costume. When his attempts to recruit Psi-Force to the CIA were met with resistance, he unleashed his Psi-Hawk on them. Psi-Force summoned the original Psi-Hawk which battled and defeated Michael's manifestation, apparently destroying it and leaving Michael Proudhawk comatose. The original Psi-Hawk was eventually apparently destroyed by the Russian paranormal Rodstvow, but later returned.
powers: manipulation of energy which was apparently psionic in origin

michael romanger.name: Michael Romanger
michael romanger.first_appearance: Unbeatable Squirrel Girl: Squirrel Meets World
michael romanger.origin: Mike Romanger was born in a secret Hydra facility as an experiment by the Human Leverage Research Division. When Hydra shut down the division, his parents were reassigned to different Hydra facilities. They made sure he was safe and left their teenage son alone in their Shady Oaks, New Jersey warning him not to draw Hydra's attention. Using advanced robotics equipment and 3-D printers his parents left behind, Mike created robotic duplicates of his parents to keep things appearing normal at school. Seeking to get into Hydra himself, he began planting recording devices across the city and stealing machinery for his experiments. Animals, squirrels in particular, were interfering with his technology, so he deployed hundreds of traps to get rid of them. The new town hero Squirrel Girl began dismantling his traps, so Mike became increasingly fixated on her. He deployed sonic devices that drove dogs into a panic, turning them against the squirrels. He staged a hot air balloon flying away with a zucchini rigged with speakers to sound like a crying baby specifically to test Squirrel Girl's capabilities. He then deployed dogs equipped with explosive ticks that would release poison gas at the announced time. After his robot "parents" were exposed and his home base was compromised, he manipulated online messaging to drive the public opinion against Squirrel Girl. Finally, he unleashed his endgame, kidnapping the baby Dante Santino that Doreen was babysitting and several of her squirrel allies. He threatened them with the Deathcruncher, a suit of mechanized armor equipped with electric shocks, explosive rockets, and deadly attacks. He also prepared hundreds of robots underground, ready to destroy the city. Squirrel Girl arrived to save her allies, but hundreds of micro-bots swarmed her and her squirrel army. Ana Sofía Romero uploaded squirrel personalities into the bots, causing them to stop attacking. Furious, Micro-Manager destroyed them and activated the Deathcruncher armor, releasing the underground chomping robots. Micro-Manager's plans fell apart as the Squirrel Scouts worked together to destroy the gnashmouths, while Squirrel Girl tore of pieces of his armor, eventually crippling it. She saved the baby and her squirrel friends, and the Avengers Thor and Black Widow finally showed up in time to take Micro-Manager into custody. While in detention, he was approached by his mother who offered to recruit him into Hydra.
abilities: Super-Villain Class Intelligence: Mike Romanger is very smart and can build very hi-tech things with little resources.

michael rossi.name: Michael Rossi
michael rossi.origin: ===Early Life=== Michael Rossi was a Colonel in the US Air Force he was later recruited into Air Force Special Operations. While serving he met a new recruit Carol Danvers when she enlisted in the Air Force. ===Air Force Special Operations=== He was sent undercover to Afghanistan to investigate the Roxxon oil pipeline. But he was actually there to find Carol who was kidnapped by Ghazi Rashid. She escaped to his safe house and the two returned to the United States. He later recruited her to join Air Force intelligence and they worked on the Rashid case together. The two's first mission together was to Berlin it was on this mission she began calling him "Ace". They travelled there to find Vitamin but he was able to escape. ===C.I.A.=== Later, Rossi was assigned to work under Stephen Lang on a government project to determine the origin of mutants, and what should be done about them. Lang secretly wished to wipe out mutants, but took money from the Council of the Chosen, who were secretly members of the mostly mutant Hellfire Club who wanted to learn how to control other mutants and didn't suspect Lang's true motives. When Rossi discovered Lang's intentions, he threatened to inform the Council. As a result, Lang had a plane containing Rossi shot down. ===Hellfire Club=== Rossi was presumed dead in the plane crash, but had secretly been saved by two of the Hellfire Club's members, Emma Frost and Harry Leland. Frost read Rossi's mind and discovered that Lang and the Hellfire Club's own Edward Buckman intended to eliminate mutants, and along with Sebastian Shaw, overthrew Buckman and took over the club. Rossi later helped thwart an attempt by Henry Gyrich and his Sentinels to capture the New Mutants, and stayed at Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters for a time. ===Rogue/Carol Danvers=== Afterward, Rossi infiltrated the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier to find out more about the Hellfire Club and Shaw. He was found out, however by two S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, Price and Garwood, and beaten by Garwood, who was a double agent for the Hellfire Club. Before being attacked, Rossi had left part of a message on Xavier's answering machine, which was heard by Rogue, who had permanently absorbed the memories, emotions, and powers of Carol Danvers. The Danvers personality took over Rogue's, and she flew to Rossi's rescue. Garwood killed Price to cover his tracks, and was about to kill Rossi when Danvers as Rogue broke into the Helicarrier and saved him. She flew him to her family's Cape Cod summer house to recuperate. He was confused on waking to hear Rogue addressing him as if she were Carol. When Rogue's own personality returned, she shamefully revealed to Rossi what she'd done to Carol, Rossi told her he wanted to kill her for what she'd done, and walked away. ===Ultron=== He was later captured by Ultron and brainwashed into kidnapping Sparrow. ===Dark Reign=== During Dark Reign, he revealed to Carol that he was alive and enlisted her help to take down Ghazi Rashid and Project Ascension.
weapons: Michael Rossi often used conventional firearms.

When Rossi discovered Lang's intentions, he threatened to inform the Council. As a result, Lang had a plane containing Rossi shot down. ===Hellfire Club=== Rossi was presumed dead in the plane crash, but had secretly been saved by two of the Hellfire Club's members, Emma Frost and Harry Leland. Frost read Rossi's mind and discovered that Lang and the Hellfire Club's own Edward Buckman intended to eliminate mutants, and along with Sebastian Shaw, overthrew Buckman and took over the club. Rossi later helped thwart an attempt by Henry Gyrich and his Sentinels to capture the New Mutants, and stayed at Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters for a time. ===Rogue/Carol Danvers=== Afterward, Rossi infiltrated the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier to find out more about the Hellfire Club and Shaw. He was found out, however by two S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, Price and Garwood, and beaten by Garwood, who was a double agent for the Hellfire Club. Before being attacked, Rossi had left part of a message on Xavier's answering machine, which was heard by Rogue, who had permanently absorbed the memories, emotions, and powers of Carol Danvers. The Danvers personality took over Rogue's, and she flew to Rossi's rescue. Garwood killed Price to cover his tracks, and was about to kill Rossi when Danvers as Rogue broke into the Helicarrier and saved him. She flew him to her family's Cape Cod summer house to recuperate. He was confused on waking to hear Rogue addressing him as if she were Carol. When Rogue's own personality returned, she shamefully revealed to Rossi what she'd done to Carol, Rossi told her he wanted to kill her for what she'd done, and walked away. ===Ultron=== He was later captured by Ultron and brainwashed into kidnapping Sparrow. ===Dark Reign=== During Dark Reign, he revealed to Carol that he was alive and enlisted her help to take down Ghazi Rashid and Project Ascension.
weapons: Michael Rossi often used conventional firearms.

michael sadler.name: Michael Sadler
michael sadler.origin: Michael Sadler was the first-born child of Louis Sadler, the Canadian hero known as Major Mapleleaf. The birth of his son was one of the reasons for Sadler to go public with his identity. As a child, Michael soon had a younger brother, Edmond, and the two often played together. Their father turned out to be rough and abusive. When he grew up, Michael came out as gay. However, Michael contracted HIV and eventually died of AIDS. The death of his son sent Sadler into a deep depression. In a drunken rage, he attacked Toronto General Hospital when a cause celebre case of a baby with AIDS, Joanne, captured the media's attention. Sadler battled with Northstar, who later came out as gay himself as a result of their confrontation.

michael scott.name: Michael Scott
michael scott.origin: As a young man, Micky & Josie's father left the family under undisclosed conditions, which caused Micky to start mixing with the wrong crowd. thumb|left|175px Sometime later Micky and Josie encountered and befriended Meggan before she learned how to control her powers effectively. At this time in her life she resembled a were-creature with bat like wings and she was living in an abandoned building near their home. For a number of weeks the two brought her things she needed, mostly food and clothing, and stayed with her and kept her calm. When Captain Britain stumbled upon Meggan when she attacked a homeless man named Sidney Crumb because he stunk like a dead animal. He chased her into her hideout and the two fought each other in the dark. Minutes later Josie and Micky arrived and confronted Captain Britain and tried to explain about their friend as Meggan watched from above. Thinking he was going to attack her only friends, Meggan attacked Captain Britain again which caused several beams to become dislodged and fell on top of Micky killing him. Both Captain Britain and Meggan were consumed with grief over the death of Micky. Meggan hid from Josie but stayed close to her family vowing to protect them, but not to come near them in fear of harming them further and Captain Britain threw himself into crime fighting almost to the point of exhaustion.

michael silk.name: Michael Silk
michael silk.origin: Mickey was a mutant. Strange incidents had seemed to follow him around for several years, such as fires and explosions, and many believed erroneously that Mickey was an arsonist without guessing the truth. He had been through several foster parents. After Henry and Samantha Silk took him as a foster child, they had similar experiences to their predecessors, and Mickey denied any knowledge of the incidents which occurred intermittently. There was an explosion in the school during a baseball game that sent him into a panic, and he fled still wearing his baseball uniform. Fleeing to Los Angeles, Mickey became paranoid and delusional, seeing danger all around him. The police briefly caught him, but then he escaped and fled to the local bus depot, where he encountered Tigra of the Avengers. Sympathizing with his problems, Tigra agreed to help the terrified youth. The two of them hid out together in a clock tower as Spider-Woman (hired by the Silks) scoured the city looking for Mickey. As Mickey's powers activated the toll bell in the tower, Spider-Woman investigated and found Tigra protecting Silk. After a cursory clash, they deduced that Mickey was causing the things that were happening, and they began calling him "Poltergeist". Spider-Woman promised not to turn Mickey or Tigra over to the police, but when she returned to give them the message after advising the police that she was responsible for the noise, they had mysteriously vanished. Poltergeist and Tigra had been kidnapped by the Locksmith and the psychic Tick Tock as they cleansed all of San Francisco of its super-humans. Mickey was attached to a device to neutralize his powers via a "brain-lock," which sent a mild electrical pulse through his brain to render him catatonic. When Spider-Woman was also captured by the Locksmith, she managed to get Tigra to insult Poltergeist to heighten his distress, causing his powers to short out their specially designed cells. Switching costumes with Gypsy Moth, Spider-Woman freed the others and helped them to escape. While they were attending a subsequent party at the home of Jessica Drew (Spider-Woman), Tigra promised to teach Poltergeist how to use his powers. During the party though, Jessica's spirit was taken into the past by her mentor Magnus to battle Morgan Le Fay, but upon her return, she discovered her body was dead. She then wished that her friends would forget her so that they would not mourn her, and Magnus removed all memories of her from Poltergeist, Tigra, and everyone else present. Despite Magnus' spell, however, several of Jessica's guests recovered their memories of her after the shock of seeing her lying on the ground dead. As Tigra rushed her to the hospital, Poltergeist stayed behind at Jessica's house as Spider-Woman's ghost returned looking for her body. Frightened away from the house, he took off, never to return. Returning to Los Angeles, Poltergeist was taken into the Heartbreak Hotel by Kate. Poltergeist, along with six other mutants from the Heartbreak Hotel, found an unconscious Dazzler (with her powers out-of-control) along a Los Angeles beach and brought her back to the Heartbreak Hotel. Later Mickey and Kate unsuccessfully tried to keep The Beast from entering the room where Dazzler was recovering from her ordeal. Subsequently Poltergeist witnessed a kiss between Beast and Dazzler in the Hotel's sun-room, which reminded him of his own inability to feel anything without setting loose the 'poltergeist' inside him. He started thinking about Spider-Woman, whom he still missed and still believed to be dead, and accidentally wrecked the sun room's windows. Dazzler told him that one day he would gain control his powers, and then she comforted him. Poltergeist was later present when Kate told the Beast to follow his heart and to try to rescue Dazzler from the Gladiators. Later, he and Link decided to go and rescue Dazzler from the Gladiators themselves. Poltergeist and Link arrived at the Underground Mutant Theatre where the Gladiators were based, and they broke in. They found their way to the Arena, where they found Beast, Dazzler, and Max Rocker fighting against Flynn and the rest of the Gladiators. Poltergeist's powers wrecked the Arena's props and made the debris fall on the Gladiators. Flynn captured Poltergeist and threatened to wring his neck if Dazzler, Beast, and Rocker didn't surrender to him. Mickey was rescued by Link, who used his powers to force Flynn to drop Poltergeist. Link then started to strangle Flynn, but Dazzler talked him out of doing it. Poltergeist and Link were then told by Dazzler and Beast to leave the Theatre before they were hurt, or worse. Later, both boys decided to leave the Heartbreak Hotel and hit the roads to see what was out there in the world. When last seen they were discussing traveling to either Wyoming or Texas to see if they could become cowboys. ===After M-Day=== It is unknown if he lost his powers after M-Day. weaknesses: Michael is mentally unstable and is prone to paranoia and hallucinations when under stress. Lack of control of powers when under emotional stress.

michael stevenson.name: Michael Stevenson
michael stevenson.origin: Michael Stevenson was a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who, along with fellow agents Jeffrey Parks and Steven Tyler, was assigned to investigate a white dome that had suddenly appeared around the City of the Space Gods in the Andes Mountains after the Fourth Host of the alien Celestials arrived there. After the surveillance team ("Group One") had been dropped in to survey the alien structure, Stevenson was making their first radio report to their base when they spotted one of the "space giants" approaching them with startling swiftness. As his teammates opened fire, Stevenson reported that they had made contact and then his report ended with a scream as the team was captured by the Celestial Gammenon and reduced to atoms. Later, the "life-seed" capsule containing the three agents was offered to the Eternal Ajak by Gammenon after he overheard Dr. Daniel Damian wondering if they contained the compacted atoms of human beings. Ajak accepted the gift, pressed the capsule-activator and, in a matter of minutes, the three agents were reassembled into their human forms. They soon encountered Dr. Damian and began to question him but when they drew their handguns to emphasize their seriousness Ajak levitated their weapons out of their hands and up to the ceiling. The agents listened as Damian and Ajak explained about the Eternals, the Celestials and the First, Second and Third Hosts. When Ajak asked them their names, Stevenson identified himself by that name and his two comrades as Parks and Tyler but refused to reveal their full names. Intent on completing his mission, Stevenson threw two powerful punches that briefly downed Ajak and then ran outside to throw a miniature tactical nuclear device at the first Celestial he saw, Tefral. The Celestial spotted the bomb, caught it in his hand and held it above his head as it detonated with no harmful effect to anyone in the vicinity. The humans and the Eternal then watched as a message was sent down from the orbiting spaceship and most of the the Celestials teleported away to every corner of the Earth. When Stevenson stated that he and his men had to get back to S.H.I.E.L.D., Ajak pointed out that Arishem was still there and would not let them go. Stevenson apologized to Ajak for belting him and then the three agents set off running. However, Arishem enforced his will by transforming them back into stored atoms in a life-seed capsule. Two years later, after Gammenon had gathered Columbian Airlines Flight 53 and brought the jetliner inside the dome, one of the passengers confronted Dr. Damian and identified himself as S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Johnson who had been sent to find three operatives who had vanished in the area. Damian replied that their code-names were Stevenson, Parks and Tyler, then he presented a box to Johnson and revealed that it was where the Celestials had chosen to store their free-floating atoms after they had tried to flee. Later, after Thor proved victorious in a battle against Ajak and Ereshkigal, he took Johnson and the planeful of humans with him when he escaped the dome but left the atomized agents behind because human science could not restore them.
weapons: A pistol A miniature tactical nuclear device that was small enough to be concealed within a closed hand

fields.notes: Stevenson's first name was revealed to be "Michael" in the S.H.I.E.L.D. entry in . It seems that, despite what Dr. Damian believed, Stevenson was not a code-name after all. It has not been revealed if Stevenson and his men were ever returned to human form again. The fact that the capsule in which Arishem stored their atoms had an activator on it suggests that Thor could have taken it with him and anyone could have restored them just by pressing that button. It's odd that Dr. Damian, who was fully aware of this, didn't bother to inform Thor. Even more, considering Damian later descend into villany ( ). Stevenson's rash action in using the miniature tactical nuclear device seems to have triggered the Celestials to initiate the next phase of the Fourth Host's mission.

michael stivak.name: Michael Stivak
michael stivak.origin: Michael Stivak was a young Yugoslavian scientist who had been brought to the United States by his uncle, U.S. Senator Eugene Kligger Stivak in order to design a new battlesuit for national defense. Michael followed a design by the Dire Wraiths, developing a costume equipped with turbo-jets that could propel its wearer through the air like a rocket and greatly increase the power of blows from his fists. Michael's uncle was a leader of the criminal organization the Corporation and was actually in league with the Dire Wraiths, planned to use the suit to attempt to take over the United States. Angered by this betrayal, Michael had designed a much less powerful battlesuit to present to his uncle. Michael's uncle learned of the real Torpedo suit, and planned to steal the suit's only existing plans. Attempting to destroy the plans, Michael was mistaken as a criminal by Daredevil. During the battle, a building collapsed on Michael, fatally injuring him. As he was dying, Michael asked a former professional football player, Brock Jones to take over the mantle of Torpedo and the armored battlesuit to do good, which Jones did for a time until his own death.
powers: Michael Stivak had no powers of his own, but the Torpedo Armor enabled him to perform a variety of feats, including flight, punching with superhuman force, protecting him to some degree from injury, projecting , and absorbing radiation.
abilities: Michael Stivak was a gifted inventor, as he was able to design the Torpedo armor himself, as well as lesser armored battlesuits.

michael stockton.name: Michael Stockton
michael stockton.origin: Michael Stockton was a scientist who discovered a way of looking into subatomic worlds (including one ruled by the dictator Tim Boo Ba). Later, he became involved with the terrorist group AIM and was a part of the criminal M'Sieu Tete's attempt to steal the Pym Particles from Henry Pym, an encounter which resulted in Pym becoming trapped at ant size. Stockton took the opportunity to raid Pym's lab and steal his shrinking technology, becoming the criminal Doctor Nemesis, and eventually (after curing Pym) took the Wasp hostage in order to force Pym to grant him access to Avengers Mansion. Ant Man defeated Nemesis before he could steal the Avengers' technology. Years later, Stockton attempted to get revenge on the Wasp but was defeated by her with the assistance of the Micronauts and seemingly shrank out of existence. Eventually though, he returned when the shrinking effect wore off (he had actually merely been shrunk through several subatomic dimensions) and clashed with Pym once more at a time when Pym had given up using his size-changing powers. Pym defeated Doctor Nemesis once more. Later still, employed by Stane International and using Erik Josten (the criminal called Goliath) as an underling, Nemesis clashed with Bill Foster, the second Giant Man. Foster succeeded in thwarting Stockton's plans for the experimental Mass Acquisition Unit and Stockton and Josten were both jailed. Stockton later revisited the Microverse and discovered Tim Boo Ba again, being captured and tortured before escaping. Imprisoned at the Lang Memorial Penitentiary, he attempted to warn the world about the threat posed by Tim Boo Ba, though only Elsa Bloodstone took him seriously. Doctor Nemesis has since clashed with Spider-Man at the Bar with No Name.
powers: Size changing.

michael sutton.origin: At an airport, David Banner befriended another man sitting by him, Michael Sutton, because they both shared an interest in chess. It turned out that Sutton was actually a hunter, who got tired of hunting animals and he started to hunt the people he brought on his island. Once Sutton saw David turning into the Hulk, he was astonished and begged him to release the beast again. However, Sutton accidentally poisoned himself and died.

michael templar.name: Michael Templar
michael templar.origin: Michael Templar was an atomic scientist living in the state of Maine who was active during the 1950s. He was a brilliant scientist but did not have the notoriety to be wealthy. He worked with an lab assistant named Maria, unaware that she secretly loved him. Templar was in love with a woman named Elsa who was only interested in money and rebuffed his professions of love to her, telling him that she would only marry him if he were rich. This broke Michael's heart causing him to temporarily lose his mind. In his state of mind he had Maria assist him in building a device that would pull the Earth toward the sun. Templar hoped to ransom the world for 10 million dollars to shut the machine off. However, he soon started snapping out of his manic phase Maria expressed her concern, Michael angrily sent her away then passed out, destroying his machine. Waking up in his right mind, Michael soon found himself unable to remember how to recreate the device, let alone reverse the process that was now sending the Earth hurtling into the sun. Soon the love goddess Venus tracked down Michael to try and convince him to stop the destruction of Earth. Learning of the events that led up to his creation of the doomsday device, Venus then attempted to convince Elsa to come back to Michael and motivate him to create a device to reverse the Earth's course into the sun. Elsa was too busy partying and enjoying the "end of the world" to care for Michael. Venus returned empty handed and learned that Maria secretly loved Templar. However, despite this love, Michael still pinned over Elsa. Venus then summoned the spirits of Cleopatra, Helen of Troy and others to possessed Maria's body. The result caused Maria's inner beauty to radiate enough for Michael to fall madly in love with her. The removed the mental block in Michael's mind and soon he and Maria built a device to reverse the Earth's path, saving the Earth. In the aftermath they found that Venus slipped away in the excitement. Venus subsequently published Michael's story in an issue of Beauty Magazine. It is unknown if he faced legal repercussions for almost dooming the human race, and his subsequent fate is unknown.
abilities: Michael Templar was a brilliant atomic scientist.

michael trace.name: Michael Trace
michael trace.origin: ===Fool's Paradise=== Michael Trace was born in a middle class family in a loving home, however when times got tough he resorted to stealing at a pawn shop, leading to an altercation that ended up with his father being shot. Following this, he began down a troubled path where he was frequently getting in fights and trouble with the law, which shattered his mother's heart. When Trace got older, he was at his lowest. However he won a considerable sum from a casino and used it to rebuild himself, starting his own company and becoming physically peak. He sent a portion of his proceeds to his mother with him as the sole beneficiary however she never cashed them. left|thumb|Foolkillers revelation Eventually, Trace became careless and made a foolish decision to switch his company's vehicle tires to a cheaper alloy, a mistake which inadvertently resulted in his mother's death as well as a school bus full of kids. Trace became depressed, and sold off his company to pay the families of the kids, then wandered drunkenly into a tattoo parlor and woke up receiving his new tattoos. As Trace was about to commit suicide, he remembered the money in the beneficiary, which was enough to fund his eventual crusade. Trace attacked a predatory clown, killing him and adopting his dog Jester. Now armed with a mission, Trace set out to slaughter whom he deemed fools and pose/artistically recreate their corpses to teach society a lesson, eventually setting his target on a gambling company and a man named Nate McBride. Nate McBride got his family killed with the exception of his sick daughter with heart disease because he stole money from a mobster called The Cheese and the website "Two-In-the-bush.com". Desperate, he sought the help of the Foolkiller, who was expecting him. Trace hesitantly collaborated with Nate, and he began to investigate. Trace began to assault the enforcers and loan sharks of the operation, brutalizing them with vicious efficiency which frustrated the Cheese. The Cheese ordered the death of McBrides daughter, which was prevented by the Foolkiller, leading The Cheese to hire Sickle Moon to take care of things. Trace slaughtered more of the operation and began to dismantle it, sneaking into a meeting and burning the funds. As Sickle Moon begins to close in on Trace, he devises a plan to distract Sickle Moon with Nate McBride so he can take out the Cheese, as Sickle Moon would not carry out the killings without payment. Trace ambushed The Cheese and killed him, and mutilated his body into small parts to send out to everyone in association with him as a reminder, however, Nate was killed by Sickle Moon before Sickle Moon learned of the Cheeses death. Trace carried Nates body into the hospital and told them to use his heart to save his daughter, and paid for it in full. ===White Angels=== right|thumb|Punisher attacks the Foolkiller In Los Angeles, after hearing about the hate-crime murder of Darius Goode and many others, Trace began to track down the group responsible, starting with Goode's sister, Keesha. He tracks down a member of the White Angels and slices his head in half upon gathering intel. Trace then attacks a convoy of the gang, decorating their bodies to send a message. He is about to execute another assault until he is attacked by Frank Castle, who mistakes him for a White Angel. The two's fighting alerts the White Angels to investigate, and they attack both Castle and Trace, forcing the two to reconsider their stance on each other. They fight back, with Castle recognizing him under his Foolkiller alias, and not a White Angel. They bicker over sending messages, as Trace prefers to arrange bodies in a poetic manner and Castle sees no usage in that. Castle and Trace make a plan, with Trace visiting Bootleg Jack, the motivator behind many of the white angels murders. Trace threatens Jack, but Jack reminds him that he has technically committed no crimes, and is left with a warning from Trace. Trace and Castle further dismantle the hate group, prompting them to hire an assassin named Sickle Moon. As Castle and Trace further attack the angels, Sickle Moon ambushes Castle and wounds him, prompting Trace to amputate his arm with his cane-sword, leading him to fall off a bridge into a river. Trace and Castle part ways. Trace finalizes his attack against the White Angels, as their remaining members gathered for a lynching. Trace ambushes and decapitates them, and saves the victims. Afterwards, he arranges their bodies to leave a message. Bootleg Jack, revealed to be an active member, is lassoed by Trace and dragged through a traffic spike, staging the act to reveal he painted his logo with the man's blood. Afterwards, Sickle Moon plotted his revenge against Trace.
abilities: Expert swordsman and has knowledge of karate.
weapons: Foolkiller will employ whatever weapons are available, but his favorite weapon is a sword cane. He has also used a shotgun and dual 1911 pistols.

michael trudeau.name: Michael Trudeau
michael trudeau.origin: Michael "Mike" Trudeau was a communication expert hired by Stark International as head of its Long Island communication center, connecting the myriad of branches of Stark International through the world. Secretly, Trudeau was also a sleeper agent working for Stark International's competition Roxxon Oil; Trudeau answered to Roxxon's Jonas Hale, reporting to him through a hand-held device. However, Trudeau did not perform open acts of sabotage that could threaten his cover. Widely respected and liked by Stark International CEO Anthony Stark, Trudeau was invited to the third annual S.I. employee appreciation party. There, he tried to impress Stark's personal secretary Bambi Arbogast and head of medical services Dr. John Ehrmann with amusing anecdotes about his job, and then he moved to talk with security chief Vic Martinelli and Stark's personal interest at the moment Bethany Cabe. Trudeau revealed that Stark had planned a broadcast of his new prototype technology during the party, and he offered Mz. Cabe his personal company with romantic interest, an approach that she gracefully rejected. Soon afterward, Stark agreed to co-operate with SHIELD investigating the event of Allantown, Iowa. This was opposed to Roxxon's interests and, when Roxxon's other agents failed to dissuade Stark, Hale contacted with Trudeau and ordered him to stop the investigation, no matter the cost. Reluctantly, Trudeau agreed. Trudeau went to see Stark's engineer Scott Lang, who was working on test of a Jupital Landing Vehicle for NASA. Trudeau approached Lang cordially and, once he had his trust, knocked him down with a monkey wrench. Hardly, Trudeau piloted the JLV and rammed the analytical lab where SHIELD was performing its tests. He ordered everyone out, but SHIELD agents were hard to scare away, and SHIELD manager Nick Fury, who happened to be there, shot at Trudeau's vehicle. Even worse, Stark's security chief Iron Man entered the fray and opposed the JLV. Iron Man created a hole to keep the JLV on it, but Trudeau managed to drive it up. Trudeau then controled the JLV's magna-grips to hold Iron Man, and tried to kill him with the JLV's sonic disruptor. However, the weapon was useless against Iron Man's armor, and Iron Man released himself. Iron Man then released himself and shattered the JLV. He then captured Trudeau. Trudeau refused to talk and asked for a lawyer. Iron Man handed Trudeau to Martinelli, so that Trudeau could be turned over to the Nassau County Police Department.

michael van patrick clone.name: Michael Van Patrick (Clone)
michael van patrick clone.origin: The original Michael Van Patrick was the great-grandson of the man who created Captain America, Abraham Erskine. Michael became one of the greatest student athletes in the country. Dubbed "MVP", Michael was recruited by Justice as part of the Initiative. At Camp Hammond, he took a liking to Cloud 9 and watched her train. MVP was tragically killed during an incident when Armory's Tactigon raged out of control. His autopsy revealed that although MVP didn't possess any special powers, his body was genetically perfect. After his death Dr. Blitzschlag performed cloning experiments on MVP's body, first cloning it at least four times. One of the clones was given the identity of the late Michael Van Patrick and sent back home. Justice later took Cloud 9 to the Van Patrick home as part of her therapy to visit with MVP's family. They were both shocked to find MVP seemingly alive and well. Later, an unstable MVP clone was created. This clone refused the identity of "Ian" and called himself Michael Van Patrick. Once connected with the alien weapon Tactigon, this clone received information about MVP's death and grew enraged. Dubbing himself KIA, the clone began enacting revenge on the people he felt were to blame for his death, destroying two inactive clones in the process before going on a rampage in Camp Hammond. Cloud 9 and a group of fellow Initiative members traveled to the Van Patricks' home, attempting to convince the first MVP clone to download his memories into a device that would transmit them into KIA's brain, essentially reprogramming KIA, but possibly leaving the first clone mindless. Cloud 9 managed to distract KIA by playing on the latent memories of the original MVP, and kissing him, allowing her to fill his lungs with her vapor. The MVP clone, rather than wipe his own mind, instead placed the helmet on KIA, leaving him an empty shell. Abby and the clone decided to start things over, with Abby acknowledging that the clone was not the MVP she knew. Michael then joined Counter Force.
abilities: Naturally Enhanced Physiology: As a clone of the original MVP he possesses the same physical abilities of his genetic template.

michael vornin.name: Michael Vornin
michael vornin.origin: thumb|left|100px|Michael Vornin unmasked Michael Vornin was the manager of the Ross Meat Company during the 1940s. By 1944, he had organized his own gang and operated under the hooded identity of the "Head". Vornin and his minions attacked shipping trucks carrying meat from his own company, killing the drivers and stealing the meat to sell on the black market. His activities gained the attention of the Human Torch and Toro who began investigating the thefts. They convinced Vornin to let them drive the next shipment of meat, unaware of the fact that he was the leader of the gang involved in the thefts. When the Head and his men attacked the truck, they were forewarned of the heroes' involvement. Laying broken glass out on the road, the Head and his men doused the two heroes in liquid asbestos when they checked the damage. The Head then took the two heroes to their hideout where they were then placed in a glass encased freezer to be frozen alive. The two heroes broke out of the freezer and rounded up the Head's minions, but the Head himself escaped. Correctly deducing that the Head was really Michael Vornin, the Torch and Toro rushed to the Ross Meat company where they confronted him. The pair then chased Vornin through the slaughterhouse of the company. Attempting to flee the heroes, Vornin tripped over a meat cart and landed on a meat hook. It impaled him through the throat killing him instantly.
weapons: The Head and his minions have access to conventional firearms.

michael white sheriff.name: Michael White (Sheriff)
michael white sheriff.origin: Back in high school, Michael 'Mike' White was a kind guy who defended the weak from bullies and on one occasion, a bully named Piper tried to hit him with an iron pipe, but Mike, alerted by his classmate Blaire, took the pipe and bend it, scaring Piper and her gang. He and Blaire started dating, got married after high school, and ended up being named sheriff. However, fate played a cruel trick when on a visit to the doctor, Mike and Blaire discovered that she was infertile and could not bear him children. From there, he became brutal, authoritarian, violent and aggressive, imposing law and order throughout the city. Nor was Blaire spared, being beaten constantly. When capturing a guy who had broken into a liquor store, he was unaware that the man was Bruce Banner. At night, when Bruce woke up and begged to be taken to Base Gamma, Mike hit him in the hand with the iron pipe he had since he was young, just to pick a fight with the gray Hulk. He and Blaire started dating, got married after high school, and ended up being named sheriff. However, fate played a cruel trick when on a visit to the doctor, Mike and Blaire discovered that she was infertile and could not bear him children. From there, he became brutal, authoritarian, violent and aggressive, imposing law and order throughout the city. Nor was Blaire spared, being beaten constantly. michel berman.name: Michel Berman
michel berman.origin: Monocle is a German mercenary/spy, who was hired to disrupt a UN Summit and later by The Enclave to set up Security College. Monocle was hired to start World War III by plotting an assassination at the UN Summit in New York. The Fantastic Four were hired as protection for the summit. Posing as a member of the Foreign Press Agency, the Monocle is discovered by Reed Richards. Monocle unsuccessfully shot Invisible Woman, the Thing and Reed with his Neutrak Ray blaster. The shocked Monocle was told by Reed that he had discovered Neutrak rays sometime ago and took precautionary countermeasures. Monocle was captured and turned over to the police. Monocle was later hired by the Enclave to set up a private college for children of the wealthy and powerful known as Security College . Convinced by Monocle's envoys, Human Torch (Jonathan Storm) enrolled in the college, thinking it was a legitimate school. The Enclave wanted to use the children to influence and gain access to the secrets of their parents. Under his control, the Monocle would send the students out to spy on their parents and bring back information. The Enclave chose to end the program, but Monocle disagred and continued to operate against their orders. Meanwhile, Peter Parker took an undercover job, taking candid photographs inside Security College. Posing as a new student, Parker bluffed his way past the guards and immediately runs into Johnny. Spider-Man (Peter Parker), with the help of Johnny, unravel the plan. However, after discovering Monocle's insubordination, the Enclave detonated the aircraft the Monocle was riding in.
powers: Appears to be able to mesmerize and control individuals with his monocle eye piece. The Monocle can also extract data from hypnosis. : Fires energy blasts from his monocle.
abilities: Judo.
weapons: Neutrak rays

michelangelo buonarroti.name: Michelangelo Buonarroti
michelangelo buonarroti.species: Human who became a non-linear being, existing at all times
michelangelo buonarroti.origin: ===Origin=== Michelangelo Buonarroti was born in 1475 in Caprese near Arezzo, Tuscany, Italy. He grew up to become one of the greatest artists of the Renaissance. Best known for his sculptures and frescos, he was brilliant and talented in many ways: he could paint, sculpt, design buildings, and write poetry. However, two years after becoming a man, "infinity washed over him" and he began to simultaneously exist at all times. Michelangelo stopped existing as a linear being and was illuminated as the Forever Man. ===Brotherhood of the Shield=== thumb|left|Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo, while the latter sculps While working as a Renaissance sculptor, he was approached many times by the patriarch of the Brotherhood of the Shield, Leonardo da Vinci. In 1503, Michelangelo crafted the famous . Leonardo approached him while he was working in one final recruitment attempt and Michelangelo revealed his nature as the Forever Man. He tasked Leonardo to build the Immortal City as well as a door that cannot be opened, except with a special key, called the Iter. In addition, he told Leonardo about the Star Child and gave Leonardo the Human Machine and "a small piece of the divine." Michelangelo explained that Leonardo must do these things to save the world and that Leonardo must save the "Dynamo," Leonid. In 1582, Galactus, the Devourer of Worlds, attacked Rome. Michelangelo assisted Galileo Galilei by having him build an improved version of Abu Mūsā Jābir ibn Hayyān al-Azdi's device to harness the power of man. At the cost of two thirds of the Brotherhood of the Shield, Galactus was defeated and the Greater Science was born. thumb|right|Michelangelo saving Leonid from being lynched at Ashomia In 1630, Sir Isaac Newton burned down the Deviant city of Ashomia and left behind a half-Deviant son, Leonid. The enraged Deviants furiously attacked the Deviant mother, Morda, and Michelangelo appeared to her before they broke into her home. After he told her that she will die but he could save her baby, Morda tried to have him promise "No Newton," only for Michelangelo to refuse that condition. Tearfully, she handed her baby over to Michelangelo and he took Leonid to the Sinkhole. There, a pigeon landed on his arm and Leonid's cosmic powers transformed her into Mina. Michelangelo gave her the key to the Iter from Leonardo da Vinci and tasked her to look after Leonid along with Nikola Tesla, who was able to find them in the Sinkhole three centuries later (on Earth) due to its abnormal flow of time. In 1642, Michelangelo disapprovingly watched Isaac Newton murder Galileo in his sleep. Newton prepared to attack Michelangelo but he disappeared. In 1645, Michelangelo approached Nostradamus and, after thorough convincing, persuaded him to complete the daunting task of being imprisoned by Isaac Newton, the ruthless new master of the Brotherhood, for hundreds of years. Michelangelo bestowed him the knowledge that Nostradamus is the Catalyst of the Human Machine and the Architect of Revelation; thus, he would be needed over three centuries in the future and the longevity from Newton's Forever Compound would unknowingly aid this. Before leaving, Michelangelo told Nostradamus that part of him will always be chained up but a part of him will always be free. Michelangelo did a check-up on Nostradamus in 1806 and was pleased to hear he was preserving. Michelangelo ensured that Nostradamus will be freed by a boy with stars beneath his skin, Leonid. thumb|left|Reviving Nikola Tesla In 1953, Shield agents Nathaniel Richards and Howard Stark took Leonid to the Immortal City beneath Rome where he joined the Brotherhood of the Shield at the request of his undying biological father, Isaac Newton. Leonid's loving adoptive father, Nikola Tesla, was accidentally killed by Nathaniel Richards; Michelangelo took the body and revived Tesla as a cyborg. Michelangelo asked Tesla to go to the Zagros Mountains where he would find the Last Caliphate and to give the key to the Iter, which Mina had been secretly safekeeping, to their son Leonid. thumb|right|Revealing himself to Leonid In 1956, Michelangelo's plan started to come into fruition. At the Immortal City, Nikola Tesla gave Leonid the key to the Iter, which allowed him to meet a time-travelling Leonardo da Vinci carrying the Human Machine. Leonardo used a trace of Michelangelo's power to unlock Leonid's memories and explained their meeting was planned in order to save the world. Meanwhile, as foretold by Michelangelo, Tesla, Mina, Nathaniel Richards, and Howard Stark were flung into the future. Leonardo brought the Human Machine to the High Council and confronted Newton, who had corrupted the Brotherhood's purpose. Afterward, Leonardo went to the Sun to retrieve the Star Child and had Leonid free Nostradamus from Newton's dungeon. Tension between Leonardo and Newton escalated over the next four years. Leonardo represented the original ideals of the Brotherhood, being hope and free will. Newton believe
abilities: Genius: Michelangelo is implied to be the creator of the Human Machine and can upgrade it. He is the one who resurrected Nikola Tesla as a cyborg.
weaknesses: When Leonid ascends through the Human Machine and collapses time into a single moment, Michelangelo is rendered temporally blind.

michele gonzales.name: Michele Gonzales
michele gonzales.origin: Michele is a lawyer and the sister of imprisoned NYPD Officer Vincent Gonzales. She represented her brother in court after his arrest for his involvement in the "Spider-Tracer Killer" conspiracy and was able to get a plea bargain for him for a lighter sentence. Later she turned up to take control of Vincent's apartment and met his flatmate Peter Parker, whom she first encountered after Peter unknowingly spent two months away in an alternate dimension with the Fantastic Four. Parker invited her to the wedding of his Aunt May Parker and Jay Jonah Jameson. After getting drunk, the pair ended up together in a one-night stand, which complicated their relationship. When the Chameleon took over Peter Parker's life he tried to repair things with Michele. Some time after her brother was released from prison, Michelle had moved back to Chicago, no longer needing to watch over his apartment. She said goodbye to Peter before leaving, admitting he wasn't as bad of a guy as she thought.
abilities: Deception: Michele is cunning and skillfully manipulative. : Michele has knowledge of Tae Bo kickboxing and claims to know Muay Thai.

michele march.name: Michele March
michele march.origin: Michele March was a CBS News journalist active in New York City. She covered the press conference where Captain America introduced his hotline at the Municipal Convention Center in Brooklyn (which was interrupted by the Flag-Smasher's attack), and later reported the start of the trial of criminal William Cross, alias Crossfire, from the steps of the New York County Courthouse, which was to have two Avengers as witnesses (but her report was interrupted when criminal band Death-Throws rescued Crossfire just before he entered the courthouse). March also hosted a TV press conference where Captain America publicly explained his then-recent and controversial actions in Switzerland, where he had shot a terrorist dead. After Spider-Man supposedly attacked a man named Buddy Corbett (Really, Spider-man had saved Corbett from being ran over by a truck, but his actions had been misunderstood by nearby people), March interviewed several two eyewitnesses and, due to time restrictions, decided to use a good-looking one who gave an unflattering depiction of Spider-man, contributing to Spider-man being enraged.

michele scicluna.origin: Michele Scicluna was Pete Wisdom's supervisor at Black Air, the British government agency that eventually eclipsed the Weird Happenings Organization. She introduced him to Excalibur when insisting they investigate the unrest in Genosha. Scicluna and Black Air were actually corrupt at the highest levels, working with the London Hellfire Club to eventually unleash a demon that fed on the madness of human souls from beneath the streets of the city. After Black Air was officially disbanded, Scicluna continued performing private black ops work with the likes of Black Tom Cassidy and the Shadow X-Men.

Chika along with Namami were investigating when an armed Michelinie arrived and admitted being responsible for the tornadoes. Chika and Nanami fled and then Michelinie approached a tornado which ended up dragging him.

michelle.origin: thumb|left|Michelle as she appeared before she underwent Terrigenesis Michelle was a student at the Ohio State University when the Terrigen Cloud appeared over the campus. She was with her fellow classmates which included Ulysses Cain, wondering if any of them could be an Inhuman. Once the cloud went through, Michelle underwent Terrigenesis and became encased inside a cocoon. After emerging from it, she was transformed into a flying red-skinned creature that attacked the crowd. Some time later, Ironheart confronted Michelle.
